Each change the comparison passes, sorting aside, SHALL be named in the log of the run that finds it — the record an
execution writes, or what a plan, a dry run or a finalize prints.
RUL-allowed_changes_named.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-allowed_changes_named.title: What passes, but sorting, is named in the run's log

RUL-alternating_runs_no_clock_change.content:
A day whose anchored photos, in the order of the true times their GPS gives them, form three runs or more SHALL NOT
be proposed a split.
RUL-alternating_runs_no_clock_change.title: Offsets that go back and forth are no change of the clock

RUL-ambiguous_local_time_answered.content:
A photo whose local time its destination's timezone skips or repeats, and which that timezone would read, SHALL be
asked about on its own in the time decisions: for a time repeated, which of its two readings; for a time skipped, its
offset.
RUL-ambiguous_local_time_answered.title: A time a daylight-saving change skips or repeats is asked about, photo by photo

RUL-ambiguous_local_time_never_guessed.content: Geotag SHALL NOT resolve by a timezone a local time which that timezone skips or repeats at a daylight-saving change.
RUL-ambiguous_local_time_never_guessed.title: A time a daylight-saving change skips or repeats is never guessed

RUL-anchor_consensus.content:
The offset proposed from a camera's GPS SHALL be the one the most of its photos agree on — each photo counting every
time the tracks passed where it was taken — never an average, and never one photo's closest match outvoting the rest.
RUL-anchor_consensus.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-anchor_consensus.title: The offset is the one most photos agree on

RUL-anchor_offset_auto_as_configured.content:
A clock offset proposed from a camera's own GPS positions SHALL take effect without the user's answer only as the
configuration's settings for one anchor and for several allow.
RUL-anchor_offset_auto_as_configured.title: A camera's offset from its own GPS applies itself only as configured

RUL-anchor_proposal_carries_evidence.content: A clock offset proposed from a camera's own GPS SHALL be recorded with the photos that support it, the photos that do not, and the track each was matched to.
RUL-anchor_proposal_carries_evidence.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-anchor_proposal_carries_evidence.title: A proposal from GPS is recorded with its evidence

RUL-anchor_within_clock_error.content:
A track SHALL anchor a camera's clock only at times within the largest clock error the configuration allows of the
camera's own time, whatever timezone the camera was set to.
RUL-anchor_within_clock_error.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-anchor_within_clock_error.title: A track anchors a clock only within the plausible error

RUL-answer_follows_its_day.content: An answer given for a camera's day in a destination SHALL stay that day's answer when photos of another day arrive there or leave.
RUL-answer_follows_its_day.title: An answer follows its day

RUL-any_config_change_replans.content:
Any change to the configuration, in whatever area, SHALL make stale every plan made before it — prep's plan, geotag's
executable plan and merge's plan — so that none of them is executed.
RUL-any_config_change_replans.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-any_config_change_replans.title: Any configuration change restales the plan

RUL-applied_unrecorded_is_recorded.content:
Changes an interrupted execution made to a photo and did not record SHALL be recorded as made by the next — once the
photo is seen to be that photo, holding what was planned.
RUL-applied_unrecorded_is_recorded.title: What an interrupted run changed is recorded by the next

RUL-auto_reprep_moves_no_media.content: Geotag SHALL run prep's execution itself only where prep's plan moves, renames or sets aside no media file.
RUL-auto_reprep_moves_no_media.title: Geotag runs prep itself only to record a sort

RUL-band_misplacement_blocks.content: A video in photos by date or photos by destination, or a photo in videos by date, SHALL block prep's plan.
RUL-band_misplacement_blocks.section_name: 5. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 5. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-band_misplacement_blocks.title: A file in the other kind's folder blocks prep

RUL-blocked_plan_ends_refused.content:
A phase's plan that reports a blocker, and a phase's dry run of a plan holding one, SHALL end with the exit status of
a refusal, never with that of a run that did what it was asked.
RUL-blocked_plan_ends_refused.title: A plan that reports a blocker ends as a refusal

RUL-blocker_names_what_blocks.content: Each blocker prep reports SHALL name what blocks.
RUL-blocker_names_what_blocks.section_name: 5. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 5. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-blocker_names_what_blocks.title: A blocker names what blocks

RUL-blockers_all_reported.content: Prep SHALL report every blocker it finds, never skipping one silently.
RUL-blockers_all_reported.section_name: 5. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 5. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-blockers_all_reported.title: Every blocker is reported

RUL-by_date_in_day_folder.content:
Each file in photos by date or videos by date SHALL lie in the folder of its recorded time's day, directly under its
band; prep moves one that does not into it.
RUL-by_date_in_day_folder.title: A dated file lies in its day folder

RUL-by_date_untimed_to_missing_metadata.content: Prep SHALL move a file in photos by date or videos by date that has no recorded time into missing metadata.
RUL-by_date_untimed_to_missing_metadata.title: A dated folder's file with no recorded time goes to missing metadata

RUL-cache_schema_not_migrated.content: Prep SHALL stop on a workspace database whose recorded schema is not the one it uses, migrating none.
RUL-cache_schema_not_migrated.title: A database of another schema is not migrated

RUL-camera_classes_not_derivation.content:
Of camera grouping, the configuration SHALL set only which camera groups are phones and which have fixed clocks — never
how a group is derived, nor the version of that derivation.
RUL-camera_classes_not_derivation.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-camera_classes_not_derivation.title: The user classifies camera groups; how they are derived is fixed

RUL-camera_group_derivation_versioned.content:
How camera groups are derived SHALL carry a version taking part in the checks of freshness and of dependencies, so that
a change to the derivation is detected and old and new groups are never silently mixed.
RUL-camera_group_derivation_versioned.title: The derivation carries a version

RUL-camera_group_in_handoff.content: Prep SHALL record each file's camera group in what it hands geotag.
RUL-camera_group_in_handoff.title: The camera group is in what prep hands geotag

RUL-camera_group_in_prep_records.content: Prep SHALL record each file's camera group in its own records.
RUL-camera_group_in_prep_records.title: The camera group is in prep's own records

RUL-camera_less_answer_kept.content:
The user's answer for a destination's files naming no camera SHALL hold for such files arriving later, while the
timezone it was given for is the destination's.
RUL-camera_less_answer_kept.title: The answer for camera-less files is kept

RUL-camera_less_files_asked_per_destinat.content:
Files naming no camera and recording no offset with their time SHALL be read by their destination's timezone only once
the user, asked once for the destination, accepts it.
RUL-camera_less_files_asked_per_destinat.title: Files naming no camera are one question for their destination

RUL-camera_zone_offset_for_the_day.content:
A camera's clock offset derived from its destination's timezone SHALL be the zone's at the earliest camera time of its
day there, for every photo of that day.
RUL-camera_zone_offset_for_the_day.title: A camera's offset from the zone holds for its whole day

RUL-carry_forward_by_copy.content:
To carry an earlier phase's record forward, a phase SHALL copy it to a record of its own and extend the copy — leaving
the earlier one untouched, and never deriving an earlier phase's history again.
RUL-carry_forward_by_copy.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-carry_forward_by_copy.title: An earlier record is carried forward by copying it

RUL-cause_locatable.content:
Every change a phase executes SHALL be traceable in the records, from the decision and the inputs it was made from,
through the plan, to the record of what ran — so a wrong result points at a recorded choice.
RUL-cause_locatable.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-cause_locatable.title: The cause of every change can be found

RUL-change_told_by_entries.content:
The comparison SHALL take a file at a new path with the size, modification time and file identity a recorded file had
for that file moved, a file at a recorded path whose size or modification time is not the recorded one for that file
changed in place, a recorded file found nowhere for one deleted, and any other file for one that appeared.
RUL-change_told_by_entries.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-change_told_by_entries.title: A file is told moved, changed or gone by its entry

RUL-changed_fingerprint_mapping_recorded.content:
For each photo merged under a changed fingerprint, merge's own records SHALL hold its old value and its new, each with
the ImageMagick version that took it.
RUL-changed_fingerprint_mapping_recorded.title: Merge records each changed fingerprint, old value to new

RUL-changed_offset_asked_again.content: An offset changed since it was confirmed SHALL be asked about again.
RUL-changed_offset_asked_again.title: A changed offset is asked about again

RUL-changed_proposal_asked_again.content: A proposal that has become another since it was accepted SHALL be asked about again.
RUL-changed_proposal_asked_again.title: A proposal that has become another is asked about again

RUL-changed_time_asked.content:
Geotag SHALL ask the user, of each photo holding a time changed since geotag wrote it, whether the photo keeps the
time it holds or takes back geotag's.
RUL-changed_time_asked.title: Geotag asks which time a changed photo keeps

RUL-changed_time_kept_is_true.content:
A time the user keeps SHALL be taken as the photo's true time, local to its destination: read by the destination's
timezone, corrected by no camera's clock offset, and decided from as such on every later run.
RUL-changed_time_kept_is_true.title: A time the user keeps is the photo's true local time

RUL-changed_time_restored.content:
Where the user takes back geotag's time, geotag SHALL plan to write its time again over the one the photo holds,
decided as before the change: from the photo's own time, or from the true time the user kept for it.
RUL-changed_time_restored.title: A time taken back is written again

RUL-changed_time_stops_plan.content:
Geotag SHALL NOT plan while a photo it has written to holds a time that is neither the photo's own from before
geotag's first write nor one geotag wrote, and the user has not said which the photo keeps — neither writing its own
time back over it nor taking it as the photo's recorded time unasked.
RUL-changed_time_stops_plan.title: A time changed since geotag wrote the photo stops the plan

RUL-changed_tracks_asked_again.content: A check whose confirmation was made against a track file since removed or changed SHALL be asked about again.
RUL-changed_tracks_asked_again.title: A changed track is asked about again

RUL-check_covers_media_folders.content:
The comparison SHALL cover every file of the managed folders but the inbox, and of the quarantine — never the inbox,
which is the user's to fill, nor the control records, which keep checks of their own.
RUL-check_covers_media_folders.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-check_covers_media_folders.title: The comparison covers the media folders and the quarantine

RUL-checked_clock_offsets.content: A clock offset the user writes SHALL be well formed: a whole number of seconds, of any size.
RUL-checked_clock_offsets.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_clock_offsets.title: A clock offset is a whole number of seconds

RUL-checked_decision_structure.content: A decision's structure SHALL be whole: a decision whose structure is broken is an error, never ignored.
RUL-checked_decision_structure.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_decision_structure.title: A decision has its shape

RUL-checked_every_run.content: A value SHALL be checked every time a run uses it, never taken as valid because an earlier run found it so.
RUL-checked_every_run.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_every_run.title: A value is checked each time it is used

RUL-checked_extension_lists.content:
Each class's list of extensions SHALL be non-empty, and each extension in it lowercase, without its dot, and holding no
separator or space.
RUL-checked_extension_lists.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_extension_lists.title: The extension lists are checked

RUL-checked_filename_format.content:
The filename format SHALL make a part of a name that is never empty and is safe on the filesystem: no path separator
and no character a filename may not hold.
RUL-checked_filename_format.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_filename_format.title: The filename format makes a safe name

RUL-checked_fixed_set.content: A value from a fixed set — a device group's class among them — SHALL be one of that set.
RUL-checked_fixed_set.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_fixed_set.title: A value from a fixed set is one of that set

RUL-checked_folder_names.content:
The managed folders' names SHALL each be one part of a path, not hidden, all different, and none the name of the control
records' place or of the quarantine.
RUL-checked_folder_names.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_folder_names.title: The managed folders' names are checked

RUL-checked_numbers.content:
A number the configuration sets — a threshold, a distance, a duration — SHALL be of the right kind and within
a sane range: a duration or a distance is never negative.
RUL-checked_numbers.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_numbers.title: A number is of the right kind and in range

RUL-checked_paths.content:
A path the configuration names SHALL be neither empty nor blank, hold no character the platform forbids, and stay where
it must: the tracks' place outside the managed folders, the library's an existing folder that neither lies inside the workspace nor holds it.
RUL-checked_paths.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_paths.title: A configured path is checked

RUL-checked_positions_and_times.content:
A position the user writes SHALL be well formed: two numbers — latitude −90 to 90, longitude −180 to 180, both or
neither.
RUL-checked_positions_and_times.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_positions_and_times.title: A position is well formed

RUL-checked_shapes.content: A yes-or-no SHALL be a yes or a no.
RUL-checked_shapes.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_shapes.title: A yes-or-no is a yes or a no

RUL-checked_snapshot_names.content:
The settings a snapshot's name is made from SHALL be checked to make a valid snapshot name before any snapshot is
attempted.
RUL-checked_snapshot_names.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_snapshot_names.title: A snapshot's name is checked before any snapshot

RUL-checked_timezones.content: A timezone the user writes SHALL be a real zone that resolves, never an arbitrary string.
RUL-checked_timezones.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-checked_timezones.title: A timezone is a real zone

RUL-chosen_group_is_anchored.content:
A clock offset the user sets that the camera's own GPS positions support SHALL count as anchored by them, as an
accepted proposal does — never asked to be checked against the tracks again.
RUL-chosen_group_is_anchored.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-chosen_group_is_anchored.title: An offset the camera's GPS supports is anchored, however chosen

RUL-chosen_offset_checked_same_day.content:
An offset a camera's own positions gave by themselves on one day, farther than the configuration allows from one the
user chose from those positions that day in another destination, SHALL NOT take effect until the user writes which is
right.
RUL-chosen_offset_checked_same_day.title: An offset chosen from the camera's positions is held against what they gave by themselves

RUL-chosen_offset_not_withheld.content:
An offset the user chose from a camera's own positions SHALL NOT lose its effect for differing from one those positions
gave by themselves that day in another destination.
RUL-chosen_offset_not_withheld.title: The user's choice is not set aside by an offset it was not asked about

RUL-chosen_position_honoured.content:
A position the user adds to the GPS decisions for one photo of a destination that the tracks or its folder fallback
place SHALL place that photo.
RUL-chosen_position_honoured.title: A position the user gives one placed photo places it

RUL-chosen_position_kept.content:
A position the user gave for one photo SHALL be kept, while it holds one, whatever tracks or fallback come to place the
photo since.
RUL-chosen_position_kept.title: An answer given for one photo is kept while it holds a position

RUL-chosen_position_names_a_photo.content:
A position the user adds for one photo SHALL be refused unless it names a photo of that destination with no position
of its own.
RUL-chosen_position_names_a_photo.title: A position added for a photo names one geotag places

RUL-classed_groups_kept_in_offer.content: The classification geotag offers SHALL keep every group already classed as it is.
RUL-classed_groups_kept_in_offer.title: The offer keeps every group already classed

RUL-clock_change_accepted_once.content: An accepted split of a camera's day SHALL put the offset of each of its parts into effect with no further answer.
RUL-clock_change_accepted_once.title: A split is accepted once

RUL-clock_change_needs_acceptance.content: A proposed split of a camera's day SHALL NOT take effect until the user accepts it.
RUL-clock_change_needs_acceptance.title: A split waits for the user's acceptance

RUL-clock_change_needs_gps.content:
Geotag SHALL NOT find a change of a camera's clock within a day but from the camera's own GPS evidence of its photos'
true time — their positions on the tracks, or the times their fixes recorded — never from the photos alone.
RUL-clock_change_needs_gps.title: A change of the clock is seen only from the camera's GPS

RUL-clock_change_parts_own_evidence.content: Each part of a day split at a change of the clock SHALL take its offset from its own anchored photos.
RUL-clock_change_parts_own_evidence.title: Each part is anchored by its own photos

RUL-clock_change_settled_photo_not_asked.content:
A photo with no evidence of its own that only one part could have taken SHALL be given that part without the user
being asked.
RUL-clock_change_settled_photo_not_asked.title: A photo only one part could have taken is not asked

RUL-clock_change_split_proposed.content:
Where the photos of a camera's day in a destination that its own GPS anchors form, in the order of the true times
their GPS gives them, two consecutive runs, each agreeing within itself on an offset of its own, geotag SHALL propose
splitting the day at the change between them.
RUL-clock_change_split_proposed.title: A clock changed during the day is proposed as a split

RUL-clock_change_unsettled_photo_asked.content:
Where a photo with no evidence of its own could, by its camera time, have been taken in both parts — the first part's
offset putting it before the first photo of the second run, and the second part's after the last photo of the first —
or in neither, a split SHALL NOT take effect until the user says to which part the photo belongs.
RUL-clock_change_unsettled_photo_asked.title: A photo either part could have taken is asked its part

RUL-code_accepts_only_its_list.content:
A code SHALL accept the changes only where the list the command would print is the one the code was made from; any
other, the command stops again, listing them anew.
RUL-code_accepts_only_its_list.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-code_accepts_only_its_list.title: A code accepts only the list it was made from

RUL-collision_by_content.content: Where an incoming photo's place in the library is taken, merge SHALL compare the two by fingerprint.
RUL-collision_by_content.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-collision_by_content.title: A taken place is settled by content

RUL-collision_different_content.content:
A taken place holding different content SHALL mean two photos share a name: the incoming one is placed under a
differentiating name.
RUL-collision_different_content.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-collision_different_content.title: Different content is placed under a differentiating name

RUL-collision_same_content.content: A taken place holding the photo itself, byte for byte, SHALL mean the photo is already in the library: nothing is written there.
RUL-collision_same_content.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-collision_same_content.title: The same content is already in the library

RUL-collision_same_content_copy_removed.content: Where a taken place holds the photo itself, byte for byte, the workspace's copy SHALL be removed.
RUL-collision_same_content_copy_removed.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-collision_same_content_copy_removed.title: The workspace's copy of a photo already in the library is removed

RUL-config_archived.content: The configuration SHALL be part of the archival record the workspace leaves behind.
RUL-config_archived.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_archived.title: The configuration is part of the permanent record

RUL-config_authoritative.content:
Once a workspace's configuration exists, it SHALL govern every run in that workspace, whatever the seed defaults later
become — the defaults serving only to seed a new workspace.
RUL-config_authoritative.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_authoritative.title: The workspace's configuration governs it, not the defaults

RUL-config_complete.content: A configuration that lacks a setting SHALL stop the run — never filled from the program's defaults.
RUL-config_complete.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_complete.title: A configuration missing a setting stops the run

RUL-config_digest_recorded.content: A digest of the configuration's whole content SHALL be recorded for integrity.
RUL-config_digest_recorded.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_digest_recorded.title: A digest of the whole configuration is recorded

RUL-config_in_dependencies.content:
The configuration SHALL be a dependency of what is derived under it, like every other artifact, so that a change to it
never changes a run without being detected.
RUL-config_in_dependencies.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_in_dependencies.title: The configuration is a dependency of what is made under it

RUL-config_lists_extensions.content: The configuration SHALL list which extensions are images, raw files and videos, never the classes themselves.
RUL-config_lists_extensions.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_lists_extensions.title: The configuration lists the extensions, not the classes

RUL-config_never_media.content:
No phase SHALL treat the configuration as media — inventorying or organizing it, or folding it into what identifies the
media.
RUL-config_never_media.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_never_media.title: The configuration is never media

RUL-config_no_unknown_settings.content: A configuration holding a setting cartographer does not know SHALL stop the run.
RUL-config_no_unknown_settings.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_no_unknown_settings.title: A configuration holding an unknown setting stops the run

RUL-config_seeded_once.content: A prep run SHALL create the configuration from the seed defaults when it finds none.
RUL-config_seeded_once.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_seeded_once.title: Prep seeds the configuration once

RUL-config_validated_before_use.content:
Every value of the configuration that comes from the user SHALL be validated before it is used, as part of reading the
configuration — never as a separate, optional pass.
RUL-config_validated_before_use.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_validated_before_use.title: Every value the user supplies is checked before use

RUL-config_writers.content:
The configuration SHALL be written only when prep seeds it, when the user edits it by hand, by the library setup and by
the decision editor's classing of a camera group and its naming of one as several bodies, below — never by geotag, and
never by merge's planning, dry run or execution.
RUL-config_writers.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-config_writers.title: Who writes the configuration

RUL-confirmation_holds_for_its_offset.content: A confirmation SHALL hold only for the offset it confirmed.
RUL-confirmation_holds_for_its_offset.title: A confirmation holds for the offset it confirmed

RUL-confirmation_rests_on_its_tracks.content: A confirmation SHALL hold only while every track file it was made against is there unchanged.
RUL-confirmation_rests_on_its_tracks.title: A confirmation rests on the tracks it was made against

RUL-container_never_waits.content:
A container destination's decisions SHALL never wait for the user, save a timezone asked of it for the destinations
waiting within it ({need}`RUL-zone_asked_at_every_level`).
RUL-container_never_waits.title: A container destination never waits for the user

RUL-content_acceptance_is_of_that_conten.content: An acceptance of a photo's changed content SHALL hold only for the content it was given for.
RUL-content_acceptance_is_of_that_conten.title: An acceptance of changed content is of that content

RUL-content_acceptance_stays_open.content: A photo's changed content SHALL stay open to accept until the photo's changes are made.
RUL-content_acceptance_stays_open.title: Changed content stays open to accept

RUL-content_acceptance_under_its_plan.content: An acceptance of a photo's changed content SHALL hold only under the plan that reported it.
RUL-content_acceptance_under_its_plan.title: An acceptance of changed content is under its plan

RUL-content_changed_write_held.content: A write after which a photo's decoded content differs SHALL NOT count as done until the user accepts the new content.
RUL-content_changed_write_held.title: A write that changes the picture is held back

RUL-contradicted_position_kept_unless_ta.content:
A review of a photo's own position its camera's agreed clock offset contradicts SHALL NOT wait for the user: the photo
keeps its own position until the user sets another.
RUL-contradicted_position_kept_unless_ta.title: The contradicted photo keeps its own position unless the user takes another

RUL-contradicted_position_reviewed.content:
A photo whose own position its camera's agreed clock offset contradicts, lying farther from where the tracks place it at
its true time than the configuration lets an anchor lie from its track, SHALL be asked about by itself among the GPS
decisions, proposing that place.
RUL-contradicted_position_reviewed.title: An own position the agreed offset contradicts is offered the track's

RUL-contradicted_position_without_track_.content:
A photo whose own position its camera's agreed clock offset contradicts, at a true time where no track places it,
SHALL keep its own position, noted in the GPS decisions.
RUL-contradicted_position_without_track_.title: With no track, the contradicted photo keeps its own, noted

RUL-control_directory_fixed.content:
Where a workspace keeps its control records — its configuration among them — SHALL be fixed, the same in every
workspace, no setting moving it.
RUL-control_directory_fixed.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-control_directory_fixed.title: Where the control records live is fixed

RUL-control_records_never_media.content:
The control records' place SHALL be left out of every inventory of media as a whole — not file by file — so that no
phase takes a control record for media.
RUL-control_records_never_media.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-control_records_never_media.title: The control records' place is never searched for media

RUL-control_records_together.content:
Every control record SHALL be kept in the workspace's one place for them, none among the media or at the workspace's top
level.
RUL-control_records_together.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-control_records_together.title: The control records are kept together, apart from the media

RUL-copy_kept_by_folder.content:
The copy prep keeps SHALL be the one first in this order of the folders the copies lie in when planned — photos by
destination, photos by date, videos by date, redundant JPEGs, missing metadata, the inbox.
RUL-copy_kept_by_folder.title: The copy kept is the best filed

RUL-copy_kept_first_by_path.content: Among copies in one folder, the copy prep keeps SHALL be the first by path.
RUL-copy_kept_first_by_path.title: Of copies in one folder, the first by path is kept

RUL-copy_passes.content:
A file of a recorded file's size and modification time under a new file identity — at that file's path, or at one a
move of it would pass to under its name — SHALL pass the comparison as that file.
RUL-copy_passes.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-copy_passes.title: A copy of a file is that file

RUL-corrected_time_written_local.content: Geotag SHALL write each true time it writes into a photo as its destination's local time.
RUL-corrected_time_written_local.title: The corrected time is written as the destination's local time

RUL-costly_results_survive_unrelated_edi.content: A result that is costly to rebuild SHALL be made stale only by the areas it depends on.
RUL-costly_results_survive_unrelated_edi.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-costly_results_survive_unrelated_edi.title: Costly results survive edits they do not depend on

RUL-country_chosen_once.content:
A country said of a destination within one already said to be in a country SHALL be taken out of the decision — the one
value the tool takes out of what the user wrote.
RUL-country_chosen_once.title: A country is said once, at the top of its tree

RUL-country_gives_its_timezone.content:
A destination the user says is in a country SHALL take that country's timezone, with every destination within it, where
the country has one, taking effect as an inherited timezone does ({need}`RUL-timezone_auto_resolves`), over any it would
inherit from above.
RUL-country_gives_its_timezone.title: A country gives its timezone, or none

RUL-country_of_several_gives_none.content:
A destination the user says is in a country of several timezones SHALL be given none, it and each destination within
answering for themselves.
RUL-country_of_several_gives_none.title: A country of several timezones gives none

RUL-country_removal_told.content: The user SHALL be told of a country taken out of a decision, and why.
RUL-country_removal_told.title: A country taken out is told, with why

RUL-crash_temps_cleared.content:
Merge SHALL clear, as its execution starts, the temporary copies an interrupted merge left in the folders it places
into.
RUL-crash_temps_cleared.title: A temporary copy a crash left is cleared

RUL-crash_temps_counted.content: Merge SHALL record how many temporary copies it cleared.
RUL-crash_temps_counted.title: The temporary copies cleared are counted

RUL-cross_fs_all_or_nothing.content:
Where merge's placement into the library crosses filesystems and cannot be one operation, it SHALL be made equivalent:
the file copied under a temporary name beside its place, verified, and only then given its name, if that is still free —
so that an interruption leaves no file under that name, or the complete one, never part of one.
RUL-cross_fs_all_or_nothing.title: Across filesystems, a placement is still all or nothing

RUL-culled_raw_jpeg_logged.content:
Prep's log SHALL record the quarantine of a JPEG taken with its culled RAW as that, naming the RAW by the place it was
culled from and by its fingerprint.
RUL-culled_raw_jpeg_logged.title: Prep's log says the JPEG went with its culled RAW

RUL-culled_raw_jpeg_recorded.content:
Prep's execution SHALL record the move of a JPEG taken with its culled RAW as its own change, so that the next
comparison with the recorded state finds no change in it.
RUL-culled_raw_jpeg_recorded.title: The JPEG's move is recorded as prep's own

RUL-culled_raw_known_by_content.content:
Prep SHALL NOT take a set-aside JPEG with a RAW unless it recorded the two as a pair, no file in the managed folders
holds the RAW's fingerprint, and a comparison with a recorded state found the RAW deleted by hand — so a RAW moved or
renamed within the workspace, under any name, is never taken for culled.
RUL-culled_raw_known_by_content.title: A RAW is culled only when its content is gone by hand

RUL-culled_raw_moved_out.content: A RAW the user moves out of the workspace, kept whole elsewhere, SHALL take its set-aside JPEG as one deleted does.
RUL-culled_raw_moved_out.title: A RAW moved out of the workspace is culled

RUL-culled_raw_takes_its_jpeg.content:
When the user culls a RAW beside which prep set a JPEG aside — from photos by date or photos by destination, at any
time before the workspace is sealed — prep's next plan SHALL quarantine that JPEG.
RUL-culled_raw_takes_its_jpeg.title: A culled RAW takes its set-aside JPEG

RUL-culling_passes.content:
A file deleted by hand from photos by date, photos by destination, videos by date or the redundant JPEGs SHALL pass the
comparison.
RUL-culling_passes.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-culling_passes.title: Culling passes

RUL-database_archived.content: The workspace database SHALL be archived in the package.
RUL-database_archived.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_archived.title: The database is archived in the package

RUL-database_image_each_phase.content: Each phase SHALL keep its database image, refreshed by each of its successful runs.
RUL-database_image_each_phase.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_image_each_phase.title: Each phase keeps an image of the database at its end

RUL-database_image_whole.content: A database image SHALL be a consistent state of the database, never a copy torn mid-transaction.
RUL-database_image_whole.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_image_whole.title: An image is whole

RUL-database_is_record.content: The workspace database SHALL be kept with the control records, never discarded with the workspace as a cache would be.
RUL-database_is_record.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_is_record.title: The database is part of the record

RUL-database_matches_files.content:
A prep execution SHALL leave in the workspace database a row for each media file prep inventoried, describing the file
as it now is and where it now is.
RUL-database_matches_files.title: The workspace database matches the files

RUL-database_over_memo.content:
Prep SHALL take a file's fingerprint and metadata from the plan memo only where the workspace database holds no row for
its path.
RUL-database_over_memo.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-database_over_memo.title: The database outranks the memo

RUL-database_regions_disjoint.content:
Each phase SHALL write only its own part of the workspace database, no two phases writing the same rows — but the
record of the state the last execution left the workspace's files in, which every execution rewrites whole
({need}`RUL-execution_records_state`).
RUL-database_regions_disjoint.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-database_regions_disjoint.title: Each phase writes only its own part of the database

RUL-date_fallback_applies_itself.content: A date fallback SHALL take effect with no acceptance asked.
RUL-date_fallback_applies_itself.title: A date fallback applies itself

RUL-date_fallback_checked.content: A date fallback that is not a year, a month of a year or a day of the calendar SHALL be refused, naming it.
RUL-date_fallback_checked.title: A date fallback is a year, a month or a day

RUL-date_fallback_fills_to_a_day.content: A date fallback given as a year, or as a month of a year, SHALL stand for its first day.
RUL-date_fallback_fills_to_a_day.title: A year or a month stands for its first day

RUL-date_fallback_from_nearest.content:
The date fallback covering a photo SHALL be the one given at the nearest destination it lies in that has one, its own
included.
RUL-date_fallback_from_nearest.title: The nearest date fallback covers a photo

RUL-date_fallback_names_in_scanner_order.content:
Photos of a destination that a date fallback times, taking new names of one timestamp, SHALL take their suffixes in the
order of the names they hold before geotag renames them.
RUL-date_fallback_names_in_scanner_order.title: Photos of one date fallback are suffixed in the order of their names

RUL-date_fallback_never_placed_by_tracks.content: The tracks SHALL NOT place a photo that a date fallback times.
RUL-date_fallback_never_placed_by_tracks.title: No track places a photo by the time a date fallback gave it

RUL-date_fallback_no_clock_evidence.content: A photo a date fallback times SHALL take no part in finding any camera's clock offset.
RUL-date_fallback_no_clock_evidence.title: A photo a date fallback times is no clock's evidence

RUL-date_fallback_only_untimed.content: A date fallback SHALL NOT time a photo that carries a recorded time of its own.
RUL-date_fallback_only_untimed.title: A photo's own time is never replaced by a date fallback

RUL-date_fallback_recorded.content:
A time a date fallback gave a photo SHALL be recorded in the workspace's record with the date fallback as the user gave
it and the destination it was given at.
RUL-date_fallback_recorded.title: A time from a date fallback is recorded with the date as given

RUL-date_fallback_time_written.content: Geotag SHALL write into a photo the time its date fallback gives it, as it writes any corrected time.
RUL-date_fallback_time_written.title: The time a date fallback gives is written

RUL-date_fallback_times_untimed.content:
A photo with no recorded time that a date fallback covers SHALL take as its true time the midnight that begins the
fallback's day, local to its destination.
RUL-date_fallback_times_untimed.title: A date fallback times a photo with no recorded time

RUL-day_offset_kept_for_later_photos.content:
A camera's clock offset for a day, once resolved, SHALL stay that day's offset for photos of that camera arriving
later — one found from its own GPS included, though the later photos bring no anchor.
RUL-day_offset_kept_for_later_photos.title: A camera's offset for a day holds for its later photos

RUL-day_split_into_parts.content:
A camera's day in a destination, once split at a change of its clock, SHALL be decided as consecutive parts, each of
its photos taking the offset of the part it was taken in.
RUL-day_split_into_parts.title: A day split at a change of the clock is decided in parts

RUL-decision_fields_laid_out.content: A phase SHALL create every field a decision needs, so the user fills in values, never structure.
RUL-decision_fields_laid_out.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-decision_fields_laid_out.title: The tool lays out every decision's fields

RUL-decision_kept.content:
A decision the user made SHALL be kept, by every phase and through every run, while what it decides about is
unchanged.
RUL-decision_kept.title: A decision is kept while its target is unchanged

RUL-decision_revisable.content:
A decision SHALL be revised by changing it in the record and running again, the change reaching everything that depends
on it: no change the tool makes is irreversible at the level of the decisions, and a wrong choice never needs the
mutated files repaired by hand.
RUL-decision_revisable.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-decision_revisable.title: A wrong decision is fixed in the record

RUL-decision_stage_writes_record.content: Each decision stage geotag reaches SHALL write its record, even when nothing in it needs the user.
RUL-decision_stage_writes_record.title: A decision stage reached writes its record

RUL-default_zone_proposed_only.content:
The configured default timezone SHALL be offered to a destination with no zone to inherit nor one its photos give,
never applied without the user's answer.
RUL-default_zone_proposed_only.title: The configured default zone is offered, never applied

RUL-dependencies_recorded_in_record.content: Each phase SHALL record in a record it creates the dependencies it was derived from.
RUL-dependencies_recorded_in_record.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-dependencies_recorded_in_record.title: A record carries what it was derived from

RUL-dependencies_validated_before_derivi.content: Each phase SHALL validate what it derives a record from before it creates the record.
RUL-dependencies_validated_before_derivi.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-dependencies_validated_before_derivi.title: A phase validates what it derives from first

RUL-destination_has_one_timezone.content: A destination holding photos SHALL have one timezone for all of them.
RUL-destination_has_one_timezone.title: A destination has one timezone

RUL-development_after_merge.content:
Development SHALL happen in the library, after merge: a development subfolder anywhere in photos by destination — even
an empty one — stops geotag's planning, execution and finalize, and merge.
RUL-development_after_merge.title: Development happens in the library, after merge

RUL-development_subfolder_any_case.content: A folder SHALL count as a development subfolder whatever the case of its name.
RUL-development_subfolder_any_case.title: A development subfolder is known whatever its case

RUL-differing_recorded_offsets_propose_n.content:
Geotag SHALL NOT propose a camera's clock offset of a day in a destination from the offsets its photos there record
with their times where they record different ones.
RUL-differing_recorded_offsets_propose_n.title: Photos recording different offsets propose none

RUL-disagreeing_anchors_never_auto.content:
A clock offset proposed from a camera's own GPS positions SHALL NOT take effect without the user's answer while its
anchors disagree.
RUL-disagreeing_anchors_never_auto.title: Anchors that disagree apply nothing by themselves

RUL-disagreeing_tracks_named.content: The user SHALL be told which tracks disagree over a photo's place.
RUL-disagreeing_tracks_named.title: Tracks that disagree are named

RUL-disagreeing_tracks_place_nothing.content:
Where tracks of the highest rank that cover a photo's time put it in places farther apart than the configuration lets
tracks differ, the tracks SHALL NOT place it.
RUL-disagreeing_tracks_place_nothing.title: Tracks of one rank in two places place nothing

RUL-drift_window_positive.content:
The span of track the drift check looks at SHALL be set greater than zero, a setting of zero being one that switches
the check off without saying so.
RUL-drift_window_positive.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-drift_window_positive.title: The drift check's window is more than nothing

RUL-dry_run_summarises_the_real_plan.content: A dry run SHALL report on the saved plan that execution would carry out — never on a separate simulation.
RUL-dry_run_summarises_the_real_plan.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-dry_run_summarises_the_real_plan.title: A dry run summarises the real plan

RUL-dry_run_validates_saved_plan.content: A dry run SHALL validate the saved plan that execution would carry out.
RUL-dry_run_validates_saved_plan.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-dry_run_validates_saved_plan.title: A dry run validates the saved plan

RUL-dump_folder_named_as_managed.content:
Initializing, prep SHALL take a folder at the top level named as a managed folder for that managed folder, never moving
it into the inbox.
RUL-dump_folder_named_as_managed.section_name: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-dump_folder_named_as_managed.title: A dump folder named as a managed folder is that folder

RUL-dump_hidden_files_quarantined.content:
Hidden files that arrive in a dump area — the workspace's top level on the run that initializes it, or the inbox — SHALL
be moved to the recoverable quarantine, not merely left out.
RUL-dump_hidden_files_quarantined.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-dump_hidden_files_quarantined.title: Hidden files in a dump are quarantined

RUL-duplicate_in_manifest_with_kept.content: Prep SHALL record each duplicate it quarantines with the copy it kept, in the quarantine manifest.
RUL-duplicate_in_manifest_with_kept.section_name: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-duplicate_in_manifest_with_kept.title: The quarantine manifest records a duplicate with the copy kept

RUL-duplicate_recorded_with_kept.content: Prep SHALL record each duplicate it quarantines with the copy it kept, in the handoff.
RUL-duplicate_recorded_with_kept.section_name: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-duplicate_recorded_with_kept.title: A duplicate is recorded with the copy kept

RUL-duplicate_set_aside_as_found.content:
Prep SHALL quarantine a duplicate from the place and under the name it had when planned, no other stage of the plan
moving or renaming it first.
RUL-duplicate_set_aside_as_found.title: A duplicate is set aside as it was found

RUL-duplicates_quarantined.content:
Of the media files prep inventories that share one fingerprint and one media class, prep SHALL keep one and quarantine
every other copy outside photos by destination.
RUL-duplicates_quarantined.title: Of identical media, one copy is kept

RUL-earlier_place_in_this_library.content: Merge SHALL count a photo an earlier plan placed as merged only while it lies inside the library now configured.
RUL-earlier_place_in_this_library.title: An earlier place counts only inside this library

RUL-early_stop_said_in_output.content: A geotag plan stopped before its first decision stage SHALL say what stopped it in its output.
RUL-early_stop_said_in_output.title: An early stop says why in its output

RUL-edit_since_plan_never_overwritten.content: An execution run again SHALL never write over an edit made to a photo since the plan.
RUL-edit_since_plan_never_overwritten.title: An edit made since the plan is never written over

RUL-editor_answer_ends_zone_asking.content:
The decision editor SHALL stop asking for a timezone, as soon as one is answered in it, at every destination that
answer reaches and at every container destination asking for no other.
RUL-editor_answer_ends_zone_asking.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-editor_answer_ends_zone_asking.title: A timezone answered in the editor ends the asking below it

RUL-editor_classes_camera_group.content:
The decision editor, given by the user the class of a camera group the configuration does not class — a phone, or a
camera with a fixed clock — MAY record that class in the configuration: that setting, and no other.
RUL-editor_classes_camera_group.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-editor_classes_camera_group.title: The decision editor records a camera group's class, and nothing else

RUL-editor_kept_until_stopped.content:
A decision editor SHALL keep a workspace it has opened as its one editor until the editor itself stops, never giving
it up between one save or display and the next.
RUL-editor_kept_until_stopped.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-editor_kept_until_stopped.title: An editor keeps the workspace until it stops

RUL-editor_marks_several_bodies.content:
The decision editor, told by the user whether a camera group the configuration classes as a camera with a fixed clock
is several bodies, MAY record it in the configuration: that setting, and no other.
RUL-editor_marks_several_bodies.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-editor_marks_several_bodies.title: The decision editor records whether a camera group is several bodies, and nothing else

RUL-editor_refuses_sealed.content: The decision editor SHALL NOT open a sealed workspace.
RUL-editor_refuses_sealed.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-editor_refuses_sealed.title: The decision editor refuses a sealed workspace

RUL-editor_refuses_sealed_save.content: The decision editor SHALL NOT save into a sealed workspace.
RUL-editor_refuses_sealed_save.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-editor_refuses_sealed_save.title: The decision editor saves nothing into a sealed workspace

RUL-emptied_folder_removed_only_empty.content: Prep SHALL remove a folder its plan leaves empty only while the folder is empty.
RUL-emptied_folder_removed_only_empty.title: A folder is removed only while it is empty

RUL-emptied_folders_removed.content:
Prep SHALL remove a folder its plan leaves empty — in the inbox or a by-date folder, or a dump's folder on the first
run — only as a planned operation.
RUL-emptied_folders_removed.title: A folder left empty is removed as planned

RUL-empty_folder_restores.content: An empty folder put back in a missing managed folder's place SHALL restore it.
RUL-empty_folder_restores.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-empty_folder_restores.title: An empty folder restores a missing one

RUL-empty_inbox_normal.content: An empty inbox SHALL be normal — the steady state, not a missing folder.
RUL-empty_inbox_normal.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-empty_inbox_normal.title: An empty inbox is normal

RUL-empty_merge_seals.content: A merge with no finalized photo to merge SHALL succeed whole and seal the workspace, nothing being left to merge.
RUL-empty_merge_seals.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-empty_merge_seals.title: A merge of no photos seals

RUL-engine_change_is_checked.content: A photo's fingerprint taken under another ImageMagick version SHALL be taken again before a phase relies on it.
RUL-engine_change_is_checked.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-engine_change_is_checked.title: Another ImageMagick is a reason to check a fingerprint

RUL-engine_checked_before_writes.content: Geotag SHALL NOT write to a photo while the image engine is not the one the photos' fingerprints were taken with.
RUL-engine_checked_before_writes.title: Another image engine stops execution before it writes

RUL-every_change_journaled.content: Every change an execution makes to a media file SHALL be recorded in that run's journal.
RUL-every_change_journaled.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-every_change_journaled.title: Every change is journaled

RUL-every_command_locks.content: Every run, and every change to the workspace, SHALL hold the workspace's lock.
RUL-every_command_locks.title: Every run, and every change, takes the lock

RUL-every_question_answerable_by_hand.content:
Every question geotag asks of the user SHALL be answerable by hand, in a field of the record it is asked in — a camera
group's class, in the configuration.
RUL-every_question_answerable_by_hand.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-every_question_answerable_by_hand.title: Every question can be answered by hand

RUL-every_question_in_editor.content: Every question geotag asks of the user SHALL be answerable in the decision editor.
RUL-every_question_in_editor.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-every_question_in_editor.title: Every question can be answered in the decision editor

RUL-evidence_before_quarantine.content:
Prep SHALL record why it quarantines a file — its path, the copy kept and the shared fingerprint — before it moves the
file into the quarantine.
RUL-evidence_before_quarantine.title: A duplicate's evidence is recorded before it is moved

RUL-execution_jobs_change_nothing.content:
An execution SHALL change the same files in the same way, and record the same, whatever number of jobs it runs with —
the job count and the run's times in its run metadata the only difference.
RUL-execution_jobs_change_nothing.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-execution_jobs_change_nothing.title: The job count changes nothing an execution does

RUL-execution_only_the_plan.content: Execution SHALL carry out only the operations its plan records, re-deriving no decision.
RUL-execution_only_the_plan.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-execution_only_the_plan.title: Execution carries out the plan, and only the plan

RUL-execution_records_state.content:
Every execution — prep's, geotag's and merge's alike — SHALL record, at its end, the state it leaves the workspace's
files in, whether or not each of its operations succeeded.
RUL-execution_records_state.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-execution_records_state.title: Every execution records the state it leaves

RUL-exit_status_says_how_it_ended.title: A command's exit status says how it ended

RUL-extension_matched_ignoring_case.content: A file's extension SHALL be matched to the configuration's lists ignoring case.
RUL-extension_matched_ignoring_case.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-extension_matched_ignoring_case.title: An extension is matched ignoring case

RUL-extension_one_class.content: An extension SHALL be in exactly one class of media.
RUL-extension_one_class.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-extension_one_class.title: Each extension is one class of media

RUL-failed_fingerprint_blocks.content: A media file outside photos by destination whose fingerprint failed SHALL block prep's plan.
RUL-failed_fingerprint_blocks.section_name: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-failed_fingerprint_blocks.title: A failed fingerprint outside photos by destination blocks

RUL-failed_fingerprint_no_duplicate.content: A media file whose fingerprint failed SHALL be found the duplicate of no file, and no file its duplicate.
RUL-failed_fingerprint_no_duplicate.section_name: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-failed_fingerprint_no_duplicate.title: A failed fingerprint matches nothing

RUL-failed_fingerprint_retried.content: Prep SHALL take a media file's fingerprint again at every run while it has failed.
RUL-failed_fingerprint_retried.section_name: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-failed_fingerprint_retried.title: A failed fingerprint is taken again

RUL-failed_operation_clean.content: An operation that cannot complete SHALL leave its file as it was before it.
RUL-failed_operation_clean.title: A failed operation leaves its file as it was

RUL-failed_photo_named.content: A photo whose planned changes cannot be made SHALL be reported by name.
RUL-failed_photo_named.title: A photo that fails is named

RUL-failed_write_reason_recorded.content:
A photo whose metadata write fails SHALL be recorded with the reason the writing tool gave, beside the photo and each
operation that failed.
RUL-failed_write_reason_recorded.title: A failed write is recorded with the tool's reason

RUL-failure_never_done.content: An operation that cannot complete SHALL never be recorded as done, so that a re-run does it again.
RUL-failure_never_done.title: A failed operation is never recorded as done

RUL-failure_recorded.content: The failure of an operation that cannot complete SHALL be recorded.
RUL-failure_recorded.title: A failed operation's failure is recorded

RUL-fallback_from_nearest.content:
The folder fallback a destination inherits SHALL be the one written at the nearest destination it lies in that has one
written.
RUL-fallback_from_nearest.title: A destination's fallback is the nearest one it lies in

RUL-fallback_optional.content: A destination SHALL never wait on its folder fallback while each of its photos is placed otherwise.
RUL-fallback_optional.title: No destination waits on its fallback

RUL-fallback_photo_says_why.content: A photo its folder's fallback places SHALL be recorded with why the tracks did not place it.
RUL-fallback_photo_says_why.title: A photo the fallback places is recorded with why the tracks did not

RUL-fallback_placements_told.content:
The user SHALL be told, for each destination, how many photos its folder fallback placed, and whether that fallback is
the destination's own or inherited, naming the destination it is inherited from.
RUL-fallback_placements_told.title: The user is told what the fallback placed, and whose it is

RUL-filed_file_stays.content:
A media file outside the inbox SHALL stay in the folder it is in, unless prep sets it aside as a duplicate, it is a
dated file outside its day folder, or it lies in missing metadata and has gained a recorded time.
RUL-filed_file_stays.title: A filed media file stays in its folder

RUL-filename_format_configured.content: The filename format SHALL be set by the configuration, hard-coded by neither prep nor geotag.
RUL-filename_format_configured.title: The format is set by the configuration

RUL-filename_format_zone_free.content: The filename format SHALL hold no field that reads a time differently with a timezone than without one.
RUL-filename_format_zone_free.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-filename_format_zone_free.title: The filename format reads no timezone

RUL-filesystem_agnostic.content:
Nothing in cartographer but the snapshot SHALL use a feature particular to one filesystem. Of the filesystem a
workspace or a library lies on, cartographer requires what POSIX filesystems share: file locks, a rename that is
atomic, a move that fails where its target exists (by a rename that refuses, or by hard links), and syncing a file
and a folder to disk.
RUL-filesystem_agnostic.title: Only the snapshot uses a feature of one particular filesystem

RUL-filesystem_lacking_named.content: The report of a filesystem failing at a requirement SHALL name the requirement.
RUL-filesystem_lacking_named.title: The stop names what the filesystem lacks

RUL-filesystem_lacking_stops.content: A filesystem found failing at one of them SHALL stop the run with nothing changed.
RUL-filesystem_lacking_stops.title: A filesystem lacking one stops the run

RUL-filesystem_requirements_tried.content:
Every run of every phase on a workspace, and every save of the decision editor, SHALL try on the workspace's
filesystem each thing {need}`RUL-filesystem_agnostic` requires of it, before it does anything else but check that the
filesystem is local — never taking it as done because an earlier run found it so.
RUL-filesystem_requirements_tried.title: What a filesystem must do is tried at every run's start

RUL-filesystem_trial_leaves_nothing.content:
Trying a filesystem's requirements SHALL leave nothing behind of what it made to try them, in the workspace or the
library.
RUL-filesystem_trial_leaves_nothing.title: Trying the filesystem leaves nothing behind

RUL-finalize_checks_photos.content: Finalize SHALL refuse while a photo in photos by destination is not as the execution left it — gone, changed since, or never in the plan.
RUL-finalize_checks_photos.title: Finalize packages the photos as execution left them

RUL-finalize_explicit.content: Finalize SHALL be a command of its own, never a side effect of geotag's execution.
RUL-finalize_explicit.title: Finalize is its own command

RUL-finalize_keeps_placement_count.content: Finalize SHALL keep the plan's count of how every photo came by its position in the package.
RUL-finalize_keeps_placement_count.title: Finalize keeps the placement count in the package

RUL-finalize_needs_no_metadata_tool.content: Finalize SHALL NOT refuse for want of the tool geotag reads and writes photos' metadata with, which it never runs.
RUL-finalize_needs_no_metadata_tool.title: Finalize needs no tool it never runs

RUL-finalize_non_destructive.content:
Finalize SHALL change nothing in the workspace's media, its other records or the library, only reading the record that
already stands at the end of geotag and writing the package from it.
RUL-finalize_non_destructive.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-finalize_non_destructive.title: Finalize only reads and records

RUL-finalize_reads_database.content: Finalize SHALL only read the workspace database.
RUL-finalize_reads_database.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-finalize_reads_database.title: Finalize only reads the database

RUL-finalize_refuses_unplaced.content:
Finalize SHALL refuse while a photo in photos by destination holds no position — judged by what the photo holds, not
by what the plan decided for it.
RUL-finalize_refuses_unplaced.title: Finalize packages no photo without a position

RUL-finalize_reports_placement.content: Finalize SHALL report the plan's count of how every photo came by its position.
RUL-finalize_reports_placement.title: Finalize reports how every photo was placed

RUL-finalize_requires_plan_still_holds.content: Finalize SHALL refuse unless the plan that was executed still holds.
RUL-finalize_requires_plan_still_holds.title: Finalize packages only a plan that still holds

RUL-finalize_requires_success.content: Finalize SHALL refuse unless geotag's current plan was executed successfully.
RUL-finalize_requires_success.title: Finalize packages only an execution that succeeded

RUL-fingerprint_covers_every_frame.content: A photo's fingerprint SHALL be taken over every frame of the file, in their order.
RUL-fingerprint_covers_every_frame.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-fingerprint_covers_every_frame.title: A photo's fingerprint covers every frame

RUL-fingerprint_covers_every_stream.content: A video's fingerprint SHALL be taken over every stream of the file.
RUL-fingerprint_covers_every_stream.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-fingerprint_covers_every_stream.title: A video's fingerprint covers every stream

RUL-fingerprint_mapping_one_to_one.content:
Geotag SHALL neither plan nor execute while prep's log gives one fingerprint value two earlier values, or two later
ones.
RUL-fingerprint_mapping_one_to_one.title: A fingerprint mapping not one to one stops geotag

RUL-fingerprint_method_is_the_builds.content: Geotag and merge SHALL NOT proceed on a handoff whose fingerprints were taken by a method other than the build's own.
RUL-fingerprint_method_is_the_builds.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-fingerprint_method_is_the_builds.title: Fingerprints are compared only within one method

RUL-fingerprint_method_matches.content: Prep SHALL reuse a cached fingerprint only when the method that took it is the one now in use for the file's class.
RUL-fingerprint_method_matches.title: A fingerprint is reused only from the method in use

RUL-fingerprint_method_unrecorded_retake.content: Prep SHALL take again a cached fingerprint that does not record its method in full.
RUL-fingerprint_method_unrecorded_retake.title: A fingerprint that does not record its method is taken again

RUL-fingerprint_survives_mutation.content: A media file's fingerprint SHALL stay the same when the pipeline rewrites its metadata or its position, or renames it.
RUL-fingerprint_survives_mutation.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-fingerprint_survives_mutation.title: A fingerprint survives what the pipeline does to a file

RUL-fingerprint_taken_afresh.content:
Prep SHALL fingerprint a media file afresh when the workspace database holds no fingerprint for it at its path, or holds
one taken when the file had another size or modification time.
RUL-fingerprint_taken_afresh.title: A new or changed file is fingerprinted afresh

RUL-first_dump_at_top_level.content:
On a workspace not yet initialized, the files and folders at the top level SHALL be the first dump, and start
initialization — a symbolic link there still blocking, as everywhere.
RUL-first_dump_at_top_level.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-first_dump_at_top_level.title: A new workspace's first dump is at its top level

RUL-first_prep_compares_nothing.content: Where no execution has recorded the workspace's state, prep SHALL compare nothing.
RUL-first_prep_compares_nothing.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-first_prep_compares_nothing.title: Prep with no recorded state compares nothing

RUL-folder_found_by_role.content: Every phase SHALL find a managed folder by its role, never by its name.
RUL-folder_found_by_role.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-folder_found_by_role.title: A managed folder is found by its role

RUL-folder_names_not_roles.content: The configuration SHALL set the managed folders' names, never their roles or the structure they form.
RUL-folder_names_not_roles.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-folder_names_not_roles.title: The user names the folders; their roles are fixed

RUL-format_fixed_once_named.content: Once prep has named a workspace's files in a format, a change to the format SHALL stop every phase.
RUL-format_fixed_once_named.title: The format is fixed once files are named in it

RUL-found_applied_never_remade.content: Changes an interrupted execution made to a photo and did not record SHALL never be made again.
RUL-found_applied_never_remade.title: What an interrupted run changed is never made again

RUL-geotag_changes_only_by_dest.content: Geotag SHALL change only files in photos by destination — never a file in any other folder.
RUL-geotag_changes_only_by_dest.title: Geotag changes only the photos sorted into destinations

RUL-geotag_executes_on_vouched_log.content:
Geotag SHALL NOT execute a plan, nor change anything toward it, while prep's log is not the one the handoff vouches
for.
RUL-geotag_executes_on_vouched_log.title: Geotag executes only on the prep log the handoff vouches for

RUL-geotag_execution_resumable.content:
A geotag execution interrupted SHALL be finished by running it again, which applies only what is outstanding — a fully
applied plan changing nothing.
RUL-geotag_execution_resumable.title: An interrupted execution is finished by running it again

RUL-geotag_extension_lowercase.content:
Each photo in photos by destination SHALL end with its extension in lowercase once geotag has executed — one whose name
already carries its timestamp renamed for its extension alone.
RUL-geotag_extension_lowercase.title: Geotag leaves every photo's extension in lowercase

RUL-geotag_gates.content:
Geotag SHALL proceed when, and only when, the workspace now satisfies its gates: photos by date holds no photo; photos
by destination holds only photos and no development subfolder; prep has recorded every photo in it; and the inbox is
empty.
RUL-geotag_gates.title: Geotag's gates are the present state, not its history

RUL-geotag_gates_ignore_history.content:
Whether, or how often, prep, the sort or geotag ran before SHALL NOT bear on whether geotag proceeds, so the user may
run any number of prep and sort cycles before geotagging.
RUL-geotag_gates_ignore_history.title: What ran before does not bear on geotag's gates

RUL-geotag_merge_check_links.content:
Geotag and merge SHALL check for links themselves, at the top level and throughout photos by destination — a link put
there since prep is one the handoff cannot know of.
RUL-geotag_merge_check_links.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-geotag_merge_check_links.title: Geotag and merge check for links where they work

RUL-geotag_name_final.content:
Geotag SHALL recompute a file's name from its corrected local time at the destination — its resolved true time, in the
destination's civil timezone — and rename it to that final name.
RUL-geotag_name_final.title: Geotag's name is final

RUL-geotag_plan_carries_every_dependency.content:
Geotag's executable plan SHALL carry every dependency it was made from itself — each decision record, the handoff, the
tracks, the configuration, the code and each photo's precondition — never relying on a decision record's own
dependencies to vouch for what came before it.
RUL-geotag_plan_carries_every_dependency.title: The executable plan carries every dependency itself

RUL-geotag_plans_on_current_record.content:
Geotag SHALL NOT plan while a photo prep recorded in photos by destination is gone, or differs in size or modification
time from prep's record.
RUL-geotag_plans_on_current_record.title: Geotag plans only on a record that still holds

RUL-geotag_plans_on_vouched_log.content: Geotag SHALL NOT plan while prep's log is not the one the handoff vouches for.
RUL-geotag_plans_on_vouched_log.title: Geotag plans only on the prep log the handoff vouches for

RUL-geotag_rerun_keeps_settled.content: A geotag re-run SHALL recognise a time an earlier run corrected, never correcting it again.
RUL-geotag_rerun_keeps_settled.title: A re-run changes nothing already settled

RUL-geotag_rerunnable.content:
Geotag SHALL be re-runnable any number of times — after a successful execution too — for as long as the workspace has
not been merged.
RUL-geotag_rerunnable.title: Geotag may be re-run until merge

RUL-geotag_reuses_camera_group.content: Geotag SHALL use the camera group prep derived, never deriving a file's identity again.
RUL-geotag_reuses_camera_group.title: Geotag reuses prep's camera group

RUL-geotag_run_records_kept.content:
Geotag SHALL never overwrite an execution's summary or finalize's package: made again, the earlier one is first set
aside, recoverably.
RUL-geotag_run_records_kept.title: Geotag's records of a run are set aside, never overwritten

RUL-geotag_summary_only_for_execution.content:
Geotag SHALL write no execution summary for a run stopped before its execution began — by a precondition, a plan no
longer current, or a record of an earlier execution it cannot read — nor for a run interrupted, leaving the summary an
earlier run wrote as it was.
RUL-geotag_summary_only_for_execution.title: Geotag's summary is written only for an execution

RUL-gone_photo_entry_carried.content:
An entry of prep's log whose photo is no longer anywhere in the workspace, and which no photo takes up as its own
under a fingerprint taken again ({need}`RUL-log_follows_retaken_fingerprint`), SHALL be carried into each later log as
it was — its steps, and the place prep last left it — neither dropped nor given a step of its going.
RUL-gone_photo_entry_carried.title: A photo gone from the workspace keeps its entry as it was

RUL-gone_track_not_used.content: Geotag SHALL NOT decide by a track file the tracks folder no longer holds.
RUL-gone_track_not_used.title: A track file gone is not decided by

RUL-gone_track_told.content: The user SHALL be told of each track file the tracks folder held and holds no longer, naming it.
RUL-gone_track_told.title: A track file gone is told

RUL-gps_time_checks_phone.content:
Where no track anchors a phone's day in a destination, the GPS times of its photos SHALL check its clock as a camera's
GPS times do.
RUL-gps_time_checks_phone.section_name: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
sections: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
RUL-gps_time_checks_phone.title: A phone's GPS times check its clock where no track does

RUL-gps_time_far_from_evidence_withheld.content:
A clock offset from the GPS times of a camera's photos SHALL NOT take effect without an offset the user writes where it
would put every photo of its day farther than the largest clock error the configuration allows from every track point
and from the true time of every photo of the destination taken by another device whose true time is known, at least
one such photo being there.
RUL-gps_time_far_from_evidence_withheld.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-gps_time_far_from_evidence_withheld.title: An offset from GPS times far from all evidence is not applied

RUL-gps_time_is_clock_evidence.content: The time a photo's own GPS fix recorded, less the photo's camera time, SHALL be evidence of its clock's offset.
RUL-gps_time_is_clock_evidence.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-gps_time_is_clock_evidence.title: The time a photo's GPS fix recorded is evidence of its clock

RUL-gps_time_rank.content:
