The offset the times of a camera's own GPS fixes give SHALL rank below the offset its positions on the tracks give, and
above the offset its photos record with their times and the destination's timezone.
RUL-gps_time_rank.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-gps_time_rank.title: A fix's time ranks below the tracks and above the guesses

RUL-gps_times_agreeing_apply.content:
An offset the GPS times of two or more photos agree on SHALL take effect without the user's answer as the
configuration's setting for several anchors allows.
RUL-gps_times_agreeing_apply.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-gps_times_agreeing_apply.title: GPS times that agree apply themselves as several anchors do

RUL-group_classed_twice_is_unknown.content: Geotag SHALL NOT plan while the configuration classes a camera group as both a phone and a camera with a fixed clock.
RUL-group_classed_twice_is_unknown.title: A group classed both ways is unknown

RUL-grouping_facts_reported.content:
Prep's handoff SHALL report, for each camera group and each folder of photos by destination, facts of the files in it —
their count, their time range, how many carry a GPS position — inferring nothing from them.
RUL-grouping_facts_reported.section_name: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
sections: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
RUL-grouping_facts_reported.title: The handoff reports what the groups hold

RUL-hand_time_passes.content: A file in missing metadata changed in place — given a time by hand — SHALL pass the comparison.
RUL-hand_time_passes.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-hand_time_passes.title: A time given by hand in missing metadata passes

RUL-handoff_built_without_links.content: Geotag and merge SHALL consume only a handoff prep built with no link present.
RUL-handoff_built_without_links.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-handoff_built_without_links.title: Geotag and merge take only a handoff built with no link

RUL-handoff_describes_workspace.content:
Prep's handoff SHALL describe the workspace as prep leaves it: every media file with its place, its fingerprint's state
and its metadata; the camera groups and the destination folders; the folders prep organizes and which of them it may
change; and what the handoff was made from.
RUL-handoff_describes_workspace.title: The handoff describes the workspace geotag works on

RUL-handoff_deterministic.content:
Prep's handoff SHALL hold the same content for the same workspace state, whatever run wrote it — what describes the run
kept apart from it.
RUL-handoff_deterministic.title: One workspace state, one handoff content

RUL-handoff_fields_of_this_build.content:
Geotag SHALL NOT plan from prep's record of a photo whose metadata was read as another version of cartographer reads
it — another set of fields, or another order of finding them.
RUL-handoff_fields_of_this_build.title: Geotag plans only from metadata read as this build reads it

RUL-handoff_read_back.content:
Prep SHALL read back the handoff it has written and fail the run where what it reads does not give the content
fingerprint the handoff records.
RUL-handoff_read_back.title: Prep checks the handoff it wrote

RUL-handoff_verified_by_content.content:
Geotag SHALL verify prep's handoff before using it by the fingerprint of its content — recomputed, and compared with
the one its dependencies recorded — never by the file's exact bytes.
RUL-handoff_verified_by_content.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-handoff_verified_by_content.title: Geotag verifies the handoff by its content

RUL-hash_detects_any_change.content: A record's hash SHALL change on any change to its bytes.
RUL-hash_detects_any_change.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-hash_detects_any_change.title: A hash changes with any byte

RUL-hash_is_the_dependency_check.content: A record SHALL be checked as a dependency by its hash — prep's handoff excepted, which is checked by its content.
RUL-hash_is_the_dependency_check.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-hash_is_the_dependency_check.title: A record is checked as a dependency by its hash

RUL-hidden_among_photos_stops_merge.content: Merge SHALL NOT proceed while photos by destination holds a hidden file or folder.
RUL-hidden_among_photos_stops_merge.title: A hidden entry among the photos stops merge

RUL-hidden_folder_among_photos_blocks.content: Prep SHALL NOT plan while a hidden folder inside a managed folder other than the inbox holds a file.
RUL-hidden_folder_among_photos_blocks.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-hidden_folder_among_photos_blocks.title: A hidden folder holding files stops prep

RUL-highest_ranked_track_places.content:
Of the tracks that place a photo, the highest-ranked SHALL place it, whatever a lower-ranked track says — a track that
places it only past its end counting where no track places it on a point or between two.
RUL-highest_ranked_track_places.title: The highest-ranked track that covers a photo places it

RUL-history_retained.content:
The records the log is made from SHALL be kept across runs in enough detail to rebuild every photo's history through
each phase — each step, the decision and inputs behind it, and the run that made it — never only the last run's.
Anything beyond that MAY be pruned.
RUL-history_retained.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-history_retained.title: History is kept across runs, as much as the log needs

RUL-image_capture_atomic.content: An interrupted capture of a database image SHALL leave the earlier image or the new one, whole.
RUL-image_capture_atomic.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-image_capture_atomic.title: An interrupted capture leaves an image whole

RUL-image_never_working_data.content: A database image SHALL never be read back as working data.
RUL-image_never_working_data.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-image_never_working_data.title: A database image is never read back as working data

RUL-image_untouched_by_failed_run.content: A phase's database image SHALL be left untouched by a run that does not succeed.
RUL-image_untouched_by_failed_run.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-image_untouched_by_failed_run.title: A run that does not succeed leaves the image as it was

RUL-image_untouched_by_other_phase.content: A phase's database image SHALL be left untouched by every other phase.
RUL-image_untouched_by_other_phase.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-image_untouched_by_other_phase.title: No other phase touches a phase's image

RUL-imagemagick_absent_stops_merge.content: Merge SHALL NOT plan, dry-run or execute while ImageMagick, by which it fingerprints a file, is absent.
RUL-imagemagick_absent_stops_merge.title: Merge stops without ImageMagick

RUL-images_archived.content: Every database image present SHALL be archived in the package.
RUL-images_archived.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-images_archived.title: Every database image is archived

RUL-inbox_kept_as_dumped.content:
Prep SHALL move no file from one place in the inbox to another: a dump's folders stay as they arrived until each file
leaves the inbox.
RUL-inbox_kept_as_dumped.title: A dump keeps its folders in the inbox

RUL-inbox_non_media_never_blocks.content: A file of no media class in the inbox SHALL NOT block a run.
RUL-inbox_non_media_never_blocks.title: Non-media in the inbox never blocks

RUL-inbox_non_media_to_strays.content:
Prep SHALL move each file of no media class in the inbox into the strays folder's subfolder for the run, at its place
under the inbox and with its name unchanged.
RUL-inbox_non_media_to_strays.title: Non-media leaves the inbox for the strays folder, as it came

RUL-indistinct_visits_wait.content: Where a camera's photos support two visits equally, its clock offset SHALL NOT take effect without the user's answer.
RUL-indistinct_visits_wait.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-indistinct_visits_wait.title: Visits the photos cannot tell apart wait for the user

RUL-inherited_fallback_applies.content:
A destination with no folder fallback written for it SHALL take, without the user's answer, the fallback it inherits as
that fallback then stands, a later change to it included.
RUL-inherited_fallback_applies.title: An inherited fallback applies itself and follows the one above

RUL-inherited_timezone_yields_to_photos.content:
An inherited timezone SHALL NOT take effect without the user's answer in a destination holding a photo, read by the
offset recorded with its time, whose offset is not that timezone's at the photo's time — one such photo being enough.
RUL-inherited_timezone_yields_to_photos.title: An inherited timezone yields to the destination's own photos

RUL-inherited_zone_stops_within.content:
A timezone a destination's own photos speak against SHALL NOT take effect without the user's answer in a destination
lying within that one.
RUL-inherited_zone_stops_within.title: A timezone the photos speak against is not passed down

RUL-init_moves_dump_to_inbox.content:
Initializing a workspace, prep SHALL move every entry at its top level that is not a managed folder or the control
records' place — files and whole folders alike, their structure kept — into the inbox.
RUL-init_moves_dump_to_inbox.section_name: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-init_moves_dump_to_inbox.title: Initializing, prep moves the dump into the inbox

RUL-init_taken_place_suffixed.content:
Initializing, prep SHALL move a dump file whose place in the inbox is already taken — by a file there or one planned
there, ignoring case — into the same folder of the inbox under its name with a differentiating suffix, never over the
file holding that place.
RUL-init_taken_place_suffixed.section_name: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-init_taken_place_suffixed.title: A dump file whose place in the inbox is taken is suffixed

RUL-init_taken_up_again.content:
A run that finds a workspace not marked initialized SHALL initialize it, keeping what an interrupted initialization
already did: the folders it made, and the dump already in the inbox.
RUL-init_taken_up_again.section_name: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-init_taken_up_again.title: An interrupted initialization is taken up again

RUL-initialized_marked_last.content:
Prep SHALL mark a workspace initialized only once its initializing run has succeeded, every managed folder and the
control records' place in it.
RUL-initialized_marked_last.section_name: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-initialized_marked_last.title: A workspace is marked initialized last

RUL-interrupted_work_exact.content:
No change SHALL pass as an interrupted execution's work unless it is exactly what an operation of that run's plan or
journal leaves: the file at the path the operation takes it to, with the entry the run's records give it there.
RUL-interrupted_work_exact.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-interrupted_work_exact.title: Only what the interrupted run's records say passes as its work

RUL-interrupted_work_passes.content:
A change made by an execution that ended before it recorded the state it left — a file where and as that run's plan
or journal says an operation of it leaves the file — SHALL pass the comparison as that run's work.
RUL-interrupted_work_passes.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-interrupted_work_passes.title: An interrupted execution's own work passes

RUL-invalid_decision_kept.content: A decision found invalid SHALL be kept exactly as the user wrote it — never erased or rewritten.
RUL-invalid_decision_kept.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-invalid_decision_kept.title: An invalid decision is kept, and marked

RUL-invalid_decision_reported.content: A decision found invalid SHALL be reported as needing correction.
RUL-invalid_decision_reported.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-invalid_decision_reported.title: An invalid decision is reported as needing correction

RUL-invalid_value_located.content:
The report of an invalid value SHALL name the record and the field it was written in — for a decision, also the
destination, the camera group or the file it is about.
RUL-invalid_value_located.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-invalid_value_located.title: An invalid value is named where it was written

RUL-invalid_value_never_repaired.content: A value SHALL be used as written or not at all: never repaired.
RUL-invalid_value_never_repaired.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-invalid_value_never_repaired.title: An invalid value is never repaired

RUL-invalid_value_stops.content: A value found invalid SHALL stop the phase as a stale dependency does, nothing made from it and nothing changed.
RUL-invalid_value_stops.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-invalid_value_stops.title: An invalid value stops the phase before it changes anything

RUL-jobs_change_nothing.content:
Prep's plan of a workspace SHALL be the same whatever number of jobs it runs with: the same operations, names and
fingerprints.
RUL-jobs_change_nothing.section_name: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-jobs_change_nothing.title: The job count changes nothing planned

RUL-jobs_recorded_nowhere.content: The number of jobs SHALL be recorded in no plan, configuration or handoff.
RUL-jobs_recorded_nowhere.section_name: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-jobs_recorded_nowhere.title: The job count is recorded nowhere

RUL-journal_never_torn.content: An interruption SHALL leave prep's journal as its last save left it, never part-written.
RUL-journal_never_torn.title: The journal is never left torn

RUL-kept_offset_rests_on_its_tracks.content:
An offset found from a camera's own GPS SHALL be kept for later photos only while every track file it was found from is
there unchanged.
RUL-kept_offset_rests_on_its_tracks.title: A kept offset rests on what it was found from

RUL-kept_offset_yields_to_new_photo.content:
An offset found from a camera's own GPS SHALL be kept for later photos only while no proposal its own GPS now gives that
day — photos arrived since included — disagrees with it beyond the tolerance the configuration allows an accepted
offset, ties, or fixes it only to within a stay.
RUL-kept_offset_yields_to_new_photo.title: A kept offset yields to a photo that says otherwise

RUL-kept_time_not_clock_evidence.content: Geotag SHALL NOT take a time the user kept as evidence of the clock offset of the photo's camera.
RUL-kept_time_not_clock_evidence.title: A kept time is no reading of the camera's clock

RUL-kept_time_tag_disagreement_recorded.content:
Each photo whose time geotag asks about whether to keep, and whose offset tag holds an offset its destination's
timezone does not give at that time, SHALL be recorded in the time decisions as such, with the offset its tag holds and
the timezone's.
RUL-kept_time_tag_disagreement_recorded.title: A kept time's offset tag that its zone does not give is recorded

RUL-kept_time_tag_disagreement_told.content:
Geotag SHALL tell the user of each photo whose time it asks about whether to keep, and whose offset tag holds an offset
its destination's timezone does not give at that time, naming the photo.
RUL-kept_time_tag_disagreement_told.title: A kept time's offset tag that its zone does not give is told

RUL-known_when_classified.content:
A camera group SHALL be known when the configuration classes it as a phone or as a camera with a fixed clock, and
unknown otherwise.
RUL-known_when_classified.title: A camera group is known once it is classified

RUL-library_confirmed_before_lock.content:
Merge SHALL take the workspace's lock first, then check the library's place and its mark, and only then take the
library's lock, so that no lock is ever left in a folder that is not a library — a merge stopped at any of these steps
having changed nothing in the library.
RUL-library_confirmed_before_lock.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_confirmed_before_lock.title: The library is confirmed before it is locked

RUL-library_creates_only_placements.content:
Beyond its mark and its lock, merge SHALL create in the library only the photos it places, the folders they go into,
while a photo crosses filesystems its temporary copy, and, while it tries the library's filesystem, the files it tries
it with.
RUL-library_creates_only_placements.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_creates_only_placements.title: Merge creates in the library only what it places

RUL-library_file_read_once.content: A library file's fingerprint SHALL be computed only when a collision needs it.
RUL-library_file_read_once.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_file_read_once.title: A library file is read at most once while unchanged

RUL-library_file_rechecked_before_remova.content:
Before a photo is removed from the workspace because the library already holds it, the library file SHALL be
fingerprinted again, whatever is kept.
RUL-library_file_rechecked_before_remova.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_file_rechecked_before_remova.title: A library file is fingerprinted again before a photo it holds is removed

RUL-library_fingerprint_kept.content:
A library file's fingerprint, once computed, SHALL be kept, so that a library file unchanged since is never
fingerprinted again in the workspace, in that run or a later one, while the way photos are decoded is unchanged too —
save for the one check before a photo is removed from the workspace.
RUL-library_fingerprint_kept.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_fingerprint_kept.title: A library file's fingerprint is kept while the file is unchanged

RUL-library_known_by_mark.content:
A folder SHALL be taken for a library by one mark in it and by nothing else, merge inspecting no structure of the
library, which has none of a workspace's folders, guard or lifecycle.
RUL-library_known_by_mark.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_known_by_mark.title: A library is known by its mark alone

RUL-library_lacking_named.content: The report of a library whose filesystem fails at a requirement SHALL name the requirement.
RUL-library_lacking_named.title: The stop names what the library's filesystem lacks

RUL-library_lacking_stops.content: A library whose filesystem fails at one of them SHALL stop merge with nothing changed.
RUL-library_lacking_stops.title: A library's filesystem lacking one stops merge

RUL-library_lock.content:
Merge SHALL hold a lock on the library for its whole run, besides the workspace's lock and not instead of it, so that no
two merges write one library at once, even from different workspaces.
RUL-library_lock.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_lock.title: One merge at a time in a library

RUL-library_lock_fail_fast.content: A merge that finds the library locked SHALL stop at once, having changed nothing in the library.
RUL-library_lock_fail_fast.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_lock_fail_fast.title: A locked library is refused at once

RUL-library_lock_holds_only_holder.content: The library's lock SHALL hold nothing about the library but who holds it.
RUL-library_lock_holds_only_holder.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_lock_holds_only_holder.title: The library's lock holds only who holds it

RUL-library_lock_stale_recovered.content: A library lock left by a merge that died SHALL be recognisable as stale, and recoverable, as the workspace's lock is.
RUL-library_lock_stale_recovered.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_lock_stale_recovered.title: A dead merge's library lock is recoverable

RUL-library_mark_idempotent.content: Making the library's mark again SHALL change nothing.
RUL-library_mark_idempotent.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_mark_idempotent.title: Making the mark again changes nothing

RUL-library_mark_made_by_setup.content: Merge's library setup alone SHALL make the library's mark.
RUL-library_mark_made_by_setup.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_mark_made_by_setup.title: Only the library setup makes the mark, once

RUL-library_mark_required.content: Merge's plan, dry run and execution SHALL stop at once if the library's mark is absent.
RUL-library_mark_required.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_mark_required.title: Merge's plan, dry run and execution stop without the mark

RUL-library_mirrors_destinations.content:
Merge SHALL place each photo at the same path under the library as it holds under photos by destination — its folders
as the user built them, its name the one geotag gave it — the name an incoming photo is given on a collision the only
change.
RUL-library_mirrors_destinations.title: The library mirrors the destination tree

RUL-library_network_allowed.content:
Merge SHALL NOT refuse a library for the kind of filesystem it lies on, a network filesystem among them, while that
filesystem does what merge needs of it.
RUL-library_network_allowed.title: A library may lie across a network

RUL-library_never_altered.content:
Merge SHALL never rename, overwrite, move, delete or change a file already in the library, an incoming photo whose place
is taken giving way instead.
RUL-library_never_altered.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_never_altered.title: Merge never alters the library

RUL-library_no_database.content: The library SHALL hold no database of record.
RUL-library_no_database.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-library_no_database.title: The library holds no database

RUL-library_not_scanned.content:
Merge SHALL touch the library only at the places its photos go, and read a library file only when one is already there —
never scanning, indexing or de-duplicating the library.
RUL-library_not_scanned.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_not_scanned.title: Merge reads the library only where it places a photo

RUL-library_outside_every_workspace.content: A folder SHALL NOT be taken as the library while it is a workspace, lies inside one, or holds one among its own folders.
RUL-library_outside_every_workspace.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_outside_every_workspace.title: The library lies outside every workspace

RUL-library_place_checked.content:
Merge SHALL check the library's configured place like every path the user writes, refusing it unless it is an existing
folder that neither lies inside the workspace nor holds it.
RUL-library_place_checked.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-library_place_checked.title: The library's place is checked

RUL-library_requirements_tried.content:
Merge's plan, dry run and execution SHALL try on the library's filesystem its lock, the move that fails where its
target exists, and syncing a file and a folder — once the library's mark has confirmed it, and before its lock is
taken.
RUL-library_requirements_tried.title: What merge needs of the library's filesystem is tried at its start

RUL-library_setup_writes_one_setting.content:
Merge's one-time library setup, run inside a workspace and given a library, MAY record in the configuration which
library this workspace merges into — that setting, and no other.
RUL-library_setup_writes_one_setting.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-library_setup_writes_one_setting.title: The library setup records one setting

RUL-library_space_checked.content:
Where the library lies on another filesystem than the workspace, merge's execution SHALL compare, before its first
move, the library's free space with the total size of the photos it is about to move into it.
RUL-library_space_checked.title: A library on another filesystem is checked for room before anything moves

RUL-library_space_margin.content:
The room merge asks of a library on another filesystem SHALL be the photos' total size and a margin on top of it, a
share of that size the configuration sets.
RUL-library_space_margin.title: The room asked of a library holds a margin

RUL-library_space_short_named.content: The report of a library short of room SHALL name the space the photos need and the space free.
RUL-library_space_short_named.title: The stop names the room needed and the room free

RUL-library_space_short_stops.content:
An execution that finds the library's free space short of the photos it is about to move SHALL stop with nothing
moved.
RUL-library_space_short_stops.title: A library short of room stops the execution

RUL-library_space_warned_at_plan.content: Merge's plan SHALL warn of a library its execution would find short of room, the plan written all the same.
RUL-library_space_warned_at_plan.title: Merge's plan warns of a library short of room

RUL-library_takes_many_workspaces.content: The library SHALL accept merges from many workspaces.
RUL-library_takes_many_workspaces.title: The library accepts merges from many workspaces

RUL-link_block_produces_nothing.content: A phase a link blocks SHALL produce no executable plan and no artifact after it.
RUL-link_block_produces_nothing.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-link_block_produces_nothing.title: Nothing is made after a blocking link

RUL-link_named.content: A phase a link blocks SHALL name the link.
RUL-link_named.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-link_named.title: A blocking link is named, and nothing is made after it

RUL-link_never_followed.content:
A symbolic link among the managed files SHALL never be followed or organized: a link to a folder is never entered, and
a managed folder that is itself a link is never walked.
RUL-link_never_followed.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-link_never_followed.title: No symbolic link is followed

RUL-local_filesystem_checked_first.content:
Every run of every phase on a workspace, and every save of the decision editor, SHALL check that the workspace lies on
a local filesystem before it does anything else, its lock included.
RUL-local_filesystem_checked_first.title: The workspace's filesystem is checked to be local first

RUL-lock_before_reading.content:
A run SHALL hold the lock before it reads any of the workspace's content — before it plans, scans, fingerprints,
reads metadata, dry-runs or executes. Planning changes nothing but the fingerprints it keeps for later runs, and is
inside the lock all the same.
RUL-lock_before_reading.title: The lock comes before anything is read

RUL-lock_fail_fast.content:
A run that finds the workspace locked SHALL stop at once, never waiting for it, having scanned, planned and changed
nothing — and having produced no plan, no dry-run report and no artifact.
RUL-lock_fail_fast.title: A locked workspace is refused at once

RUL-lock_refusal_says_locked.content: A run that stops on a locked workspace SHALL say the workspace is locked by a run in progress.
RUL-lock_refusal_says_locked.title: A refused run says the workspace is locked

RUL-lock_released_on_any_end.content:
A run SHALL release the lock when it ends, whether it succeeds or fails, never letting it outlive the run: between
runs, the workspace is unlocked.
RUL-lock_released_on_any_end.title: The lock is released however the run ends

RUL-lock_through_the_run.content:
A run SHALL hold the lock until it ends — through planning, dry run, execution, and every record and artifact it
writes.
RUL-lock_through_the_run.title: The lock lasts the whole run, and no longer

RUL-log_carries_name_chain.content: A photo's entry in the log SHALL carry the chain of names and places it passed through.
RUL-log_carries_name_chain.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_carries_name_chain.title: The log carries the chain of names and places

RUL-log_cites_decisions.content: A step that followed from a decision SHALL name that decision, so the why stands beside the what.
RUL-log_cites_decisions.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_cites_decisions.title: A step names the decision behind it

RUL-log_entry_append_only.content:
Each phase SHALL only append its own steps to a photo's entry, never rewriting an earlier one — so each earlier log
stays its own phase's.
RUL-log_entry_append_only.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_entry_append_only.title: A phase only appends to a photo's entry

RUL-log_entry_grows.content:
A photo's entry in the log SHALL gather the steps of every phase it passes through and be whole through the latest of
them — so the latest phase's log is the full record.
RUL-log_entry_grows.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_entry_grows.title: A photo's entry grows one phase at a time

RUL-log_follows_retaken_fingerprint.content: A photo whose fingerprint is taken again with a new value SHALL keep its history in the log, under the new value.
RUL-log_follows_retaken_fingerprint.title: A photo keeps its history when its fingerprint is taken again

RUL-log_human_readable.content:
The log SHALL be readable as it stands, with no separate report: with descriptive names, and values as a person reads
them — times, timezones and offsets.
RUL-log_human_readable.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_human_readable.title: The log reads as it stands

RUL-log_keyed_by_fingerprint.content: The log SHALL key each photo's entry by its fingerprint.
RUL-log_keyed_by_fingerprint.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_keyed_by_fingerprint.title: The log is keyed by fingerprint

RUL-log_records_gps_reverts.content:
A manual position applied, changed or withdrawn SHALL appear in the log with the position it replaced or restored, or
that there was none.
RUL-log_records_gps_reverts.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_records_gps_reverts.title: A manual position's reversal is logged like its application

RUL-log_records_null_island_replaced.content:
A position geotag writes over a photo's position of latitude 0 and longitude 0 SHALL appear in the log with the
position it replaced.
RUL-log_records_null_island_replaced.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_records_null_island_replaced.title: A position written over latitude 0 and longitude 0 is logged with it

RUL-log_records_other_times_replaced.content:
A time geotag writes into another field in which the photo records when it was made SHALL appear in the log with the
value that field held.
RUL-log_records_other_times_replaced.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_records_other_times_replaced.title: Every other time field written is logged with what it held

RUL-log_records_time_replaced.content:
A time geotag writes SHALL appear in the log with the time and offset it replaced, the field the photo's time was read
from and the rule that turned it to UTC.
RUL-log_records_time_replaced.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_records_time_replaced.title: A time written is logged with what it replaced and how it was found

RUL-log_stably_ordered.content: The log SHALL be stably ordered.
RUL-log_stably_ordered.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_stably_ordered.title: The log is stably ordered

RUL-log_step_names_run.content: Each step a phase adds to a photo's log SHALL name the run that made it.
RUL-log_step_names_run.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-log_step_names_run.title: Each step of a log names the run that made it

RUL-lower_track_anchors_where_higher_abs.content:
A lower-ranked track SHALL anchor a camera's clock at a time only where no higher-ranked track has a point at that
time or two around it that a photo could be placed between.
RUL-lower_track_anchors_where_higher_abs.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-lower_track_anchors_where_higher_abs.title: A lower-ranked track anchors only where no higher one recorded

RUL-lower_track_disagreements_told.content:
The user SHALL be told, for each lower-ranked track, how many photos it put farther from where a higher-ranked track
placed them than the configuration lets tracks differ.
RUL-lower_track_disagreements_told.title: Lower-ranked tracks that disagree are counted

RUL-lower_track_distance_recorded.content:
A position the tracks give a photo SHALL be recorded with each lower-ranked track that placed it the same way and how far
from the position that track put it.
RUL-lower_track_distance_recorded.title: A position is recorded with how far the lower-ranked tracks put it

RUL-maintenance_unchecked.content: Pruning the quarantine, setting up the library and editing the decisions SHALL run without the comparison.
RUL-maintenance_unchecked.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-maintenance_unchecked.title: Pruning, the library's setup and the editor do not compare

RUL-managed_folder_never_removed.content: Prep SHALL never remove a managed folder.
RUL-managed_folder_never_removed.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-managed_folder_never_removed.title: Prep never removes a managed folder

RUL-media_extension_lowercase.content: Each media file prep files, or finds outside the inbox, SHALL end with its extension in lowercase.
RUL-media_extension_lowercase.title: A media file's extension is lowercase

RUL-memo_entry_same_tests.content: Prep SHALL reuse an entry of the plan memo only when a row of the workspace database holding it would be reused.
RUL-memo_entry_same_tests.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-memo_entry_same_tests.title: A memo entry passes the database's tests

RUL-memo_never_changes_plan.content:
The plan prep makes SHALL be the same whatever the plan memo holds — entries reused, none, or a file that cannot be
read.
RUL-memo_never_changes_plan.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-memo_never_changes_plan.title: The memo never changes the plan

RUL-memo_proves_no_move.content: Prep SHALL recognize a moved file from the workspace database alone, never from the plan memo.
RUL-memo_proves_no_move.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-memo_proves_no_move.title: The memo proves no move

RUL-memo_tracks_workspace.content: The plan memo SHALL hold entries only for paths the latest plan read.
RUL-memo_tracks_workspace.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-memo_tracks_workspace.title: The memo holds what the latest plan read

RUL-merge_blocked_changes_nothing.content: A merge a precondition stops SHALL change nothing in the library, the workspace's photos or merge's records.
RUL-merge_blocked_changes_nothing.title: A merge a precondition stops changes nothing

RUL-merge_changed_fingerprint_unmerged.content:
A photo whose fingerprint, taken again by merge, has changed, and which {need}`RUL-merge_merges_changed_fingerprint`
does not merge — and a photo whose unchanged value such a photo's new value equals — SHALL be left in photos by
destination, unmerged.
RUL-merge_changed_fingerprint_unmerged.title: A changed fingerprint not proven one to one is left unmerged

RUL-merge_gates_leave_out_residue.content:
What geotag's gates leave out — the videos, the files missing metadata, the redundant JPEGs and the strays — SHALL
block merge no more than geotag.
RUL-merge_gates_leave_out_residue.title: What geotag's gates leave out does not block merge

RUL-merge_is_terminal.content: Merge SHALL be the last phase run in a workspace: once it succeeds, more media goes to a fresh workspace.
RUL-merge_is_terminal.title: Merge ends the workspace

RUL-merge_merges_changed_fingerprint.content:
A photo whose fingerprint, taken again by merge, has changed SHALL be merged under its new value where it is the very
file finalize recorded and its old value and its new are one to one — neither value another photo's under either
version.
RUL-merge_merges_changed_fingerprint.title: A photo whose fingerprint changed is merged under its new value

RUL-merge_moves.content:
Merge SHALL move each photo it places, removing the workspace's copy only once the library's is verified in place — and
a photo already in the library likewise.
RUL-merge_moves.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_moves.title: Merge moves, and a photo leaves the workspace only once safe in the library

RUL-merge_needs_no_tracks.content: Merge SHALL proceed without the tracks folder, on the track points the workspace keeps.
RUL-merge_needs_no_tracks.title: Merge needs no tracks folder

RUL-merge_outcome_recorded.content: Merge SHALL record whether its run succeeded whole, in part or not at all, or was refused before changing anything.
RUL-merge_outcome_recorded.section_name: 6. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
sections: 6. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
RUL-merge_outcome_recorded.title: Merge records how its run ended

RUL-merge_rechecks_gates.content: Merge SHALL proceed only while the workspace, checked again at merge's own start, satisfies geotag's gates.
RUL-merge_rechecks_gates.title: Merge checks geotag's gates again

RUL-merge_rechecks_under_new_engine.content:
Under an ImageMagick version other than the one prep's fingerprints were taken by, merge SHALL take each photo's
fingerprint again before comparing it with the library's.
RUL-merge_rechecks_under_new_engine.title: Merge checks prep's fingerprints under another ImageMagick

RUL-merge_records_landing.content:
Merge SHALL record, in its own records, where each photo landed in the library, whether it was renamed there, which were
already present, and what blocked the rest.
RUL-merge_records_landing.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_records_landing.title: Merge records where every photo landed

RUL-merge_refuses_changed_since_finalize.content:
Merge SHALL refuse when photos by destination has changed since finalize, so that what reaches the library is always
the corrected, named, fully recorded set.
RUL-merge_refuses_changed_since_finalize.title: Merge refuses photos by destination changed since finalize

RUL-merge_refuses_unplaced.content:
Merge SHALL refuse while a photo in photos by destination holds no position, checked again at merge's own start as
finalize checks it.
RUL-merge_refuses_unplaced.title: Merge takes no photo without a position

RUL-merge_replan_any_time.content: Merge SHALL allow a fresh plan at any time on a workspace not sealed, whatever an earlier run of it left.
RUL-merge_replan_any_time.title: A fresh plan is allowed at any time before the seal

RUL-merge_reseals.content:
A merge that succeeds SHALL remake the archival package to hold its own records too, as part of the same run and with no
command of its own.
RUL-merge_reseals.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_reseals.title: Merge remakes the package as part of its run

RUL-merge_resumable.content: A merge interrupted SHALL be finished by running it again, which applies only what is outstanding.
RUL-merge_resumable.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merge_resumable.title: Merge resumes, and a merged batch is a no-op

RUL-merge_run_reported.content:
At the end of an execution merge SHALL report what it placed in the library, what was already there, each photo left in
photos by destination with why, and whether the workspace is now sealed.
RUL-merge_run_reported.section_name: 6. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
sections: 6. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
RUL-merge_run_reported.title: Merge tells how its run ended

RUL-merge_snapshots_library.content: Merge's snapshot SHALL cover the workspace, and the library too where the library can be snapshotted.
RUL-merge_snapshots_library.title: Merge snapshots the workspace, and the library beside it

RUL-merge_suffix_above_highest.content: Merge SHALL take the suffix above the highest already used for a name, never a lower one that has come free.
RUL-merge_suffix_above_highest.title: Merge takes the suffix above the highest used

RUL-merge_summary_only_for_execution.content:
Merge SHALL write no summary for a run stopped before its execution began — by a precondition, or a plan or journal it
would not use — nor for a run interrupted, leaving the summary an earlier run wrote as it was.
RUL-merge_summary_only_for_execution.section_name: 6. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
sections: 6. User-visible outputs and the merge summary
RUL-merge_summary_only_for_execution.title: Merge's summary is written only for an execution

RUL-merge_takes_finalized_current.content:
Merge SHALL require that geotag's execution succeeded and the workspace was finalized, and refuse a workspace that was
not.
RUL-merge_takes_finalized_current.title: Merge requires a finalized workspace

RUL-merge_unreadable_record_stops.content:
Merge SHALL stop, naming the file and changing nothing, on a plan or journal of its own that it cannot read — never
taking it for an empty one.
RUL-merge_unreadable_record_stops.title: A record of merge's own that cannot be read stops it

RUL-merged_batch_no_op.content: Merging a batch already merged SHALL change nothing.
RUL-merged_batch_no_op.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-merged_batch_no_op.title: Merging a merged batch changes nothing

RUL-metadata_failure_blocks.content:
A media file whose metadata prep could not read, and of which it keeps no record still valid, SHALL block prep's plan
wherever it lies, photos by destination included.
RUL-metadata_failure_blocks.section_name: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-metadata_failure_blocks.title: Metadata that could not be read blocks, in photos by destination too

RUL-metadata_freshness.content:
Prep SHALL reuse a file's cached metadata only while the file's path, size, modification time and fingerprint, and the
way the metadata was read — the extractor and its version, the fields, the options and the record's form — are as they
were when it was read.
RUL-metadata_freshness.section_name: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
sections: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
RUL-metadata_freshness.title: Cached metadata is reused only while read the same way

RUL-metadata_group_order.content:
Prep SHALL take each metadata field from the file's EXIF where EXIF holds it, else from its XMP, before any other
place the file records it.
RUL-metadata_group_order.section_name: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
sections: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
RUL-metadata_group_order.title: A field is taken from the camera's own record first

RUL-metadata_kept_for_geotag.content:
Prep SHALL keep in the workspace database, for each media file it reads, the metadata geotag works from — the camera's
identity, the times and the native GPS position as recorded, and the file's dimensions, orientation and duration.
RUL-metadata_kept_for_geotag.section_name: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
sections: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
RUL-metadata_kept_for_geotag.title: Prep keeps the metadata geotag needs

RUL-misnamed_file_expected_name.content: Prep SHALL give, with each misnamed file it names, the name the file should carry.
RUL-misnamed_file_expected_name.title: A misnamed file is given the name it should carry

RUL-misnamed_file_named.content: Prep SHALL name every misnamed file it finds.
RUL-misnamed_file_named.title: Every misnamed file is named

RUL-misnamed_file_stops_prep.content:
A media file outside the inbox whose name is neither its timestamp name nor, lacking a recorded time, its untimed name
SHALL stop prep.
RUL-misnamed_file_stops_prep.title: A misnamed file outside the inbox stops prep

RUL-missing_folder_blocks.content: On an initialized workspace, a missing managed folder SHALL block every phase.
RUL-missing_folder_blocks.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-missing_folder_blocks.title: A missing managed folder blocks, and is never rebuilt

RUL-missing_folder_named.content: The block of a missing managed folder SHALL name the missing folders and say that something is wrong.
RUL-missing_folder_named.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-missing_folder_named.title: The block names the missing folders

RUL-missing_folder_never_recreated.content:
A missing managed folder SHALL never be recreated outside initialization: no phase organizes media into a structure it
had to rebuild.
RUL-missing_folder_never_recreated.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-missing_folder_never_recreated.title: A missing managed folder is never rebuilt

RUL-missing_folder_remedy_told.content: The block of a missing managed folder SHALL tell the user to restore the folders and run again.
RUL-missing_folder_remedy_told.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-missing_folder_remedy_told.title: The block tells the user to restore the folders

RUL-missing_setting_named.content: A run stopped by a configuration that lacks a setting SHALL name the setting.
RUL-missing_setting_named.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-missing_setting_named.title: The missing setting is named

RUL-missing_tracks_stop_geotag.content: Geotag SHALL NOT plan while the tracks folder the configuration names is not there.
RUL-missing_tracks_stop_geotag.title: Tracks that are configured and not there stop geotag

RUL-modified_time_no_camera_offset.content: A photo whose recorded time is read from the time it was last modified SHALL never be given its camera's clock offset.
RUL-modified_time_no_camera_offset.title: A photo timed by its modification takes no camera's offset

RUL-modified_time_opens_no_day.content:
A photo whose recorded time is read from the time it was last modified SHALL never open a day of its camera's clock
offsets, nor be counted in one.
RUL-modified_time_opens_no_day.title: A photo timed by its modification is in none of its camera's days

RUL-modified_time_solved_alone.content:
A photo whose recorded time is read from the time it was last modified SHALL be solved on its own, as a file naming no
camera is, whatever camera its metadata names.
RUL-modified_time_solved_alone.title: A photo timed by its modification is solved on its own

RUL-more_dumps_until_merge.content:
A new dump SHALL be accepted into the inbox at any point before merge, after a successful geotag too; the loop then
resumes from prep.
RUL-more_dumps_until_merge.title: More dumps may follow until merge

RUL-move_recognized.content:
Prep SHALL recognize as moved a file new to photos by destination whose size, modification time and name are those of
a file the workspace database holds and that is gone from its path — one only, matched by no other such file and by no
other new file in photos by destination.
RUL-move_recognized.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-move_recognized.title: A file the user moved is recognized

RUL-moved_back_passes.content: A photo moved back from photos by destination into photos by date SHALL pass the comparison.
RUL-moved_back_passes.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-moved_back_passes.title: A photo moved back passes

RUL-moved_file_carried.content:
Prep SHALL carry a moved file's row to its new path, reading nothing of the file but its size and time when the row
would have been reused at the old path.
RUL-moved_file_carried.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-moved_file_carried.title: A moved file's identity is carried, not read again

RUL-moved_file_stale_read_again.content:
Prep SHALL read a moved file again at its new path, as it would have been read at the old, when its row would not have
been reused there.
RUL-moved_file_stale_read_again.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-moved_file_stale_read_again.title: A moved file whose row is stale is read again where it now is

RUL-moved_photo_decided_anew.content:
A photo moved to another destination SHALL be decided under that destination's timezone and clock offset, nothing of
its old destination carried with it.
RUL-moved_photo_decided_anew.title: A moved photo is decided where it now is

RUL-moved_photo_position_decided_anew.content:
A photo moved to another destination — its folder renamed among the ways — SHALL be placed with no position decision
made for it in its old destination carried with it.
RUL-moved_photo_position_decided_anew.title: A moved photo's position is decided anew

RUL-mutate_on_difference.content:
In every phase and every run, a file SHALL be moved, renamed or written only where its current state differs from what
the run requires of it: a file already in its place, with its name and its metadata, produces no operation.
RUL-mutate_on_difference.title: A file is changed only where it differs

RUL-names_local_in_repeated_hour.content:
In the hour a destination's zone repeats as its clocks go back, geotag SHALL name each photo by its local time there,
so that the names of that hour sort by local time and not by true time.
RUL-names_local_in_repeated_hour.title: In the hour a zone repeats, names are its local time

RUL-neighbour_day_keeps_its_cell.content: A day proposed its neighbour's offset SHALL NOT be joined to its neighbour: it keeps a decision of its own.
RUL-neighbour_day_keeps_its_cell.title: The day stays the unit

RUL-neighbour_day_no_gap_bound.content: A neighbouring day's offset SHALL be proposed however much time lies between its photos and the day's.
RUL-neighbour_day_no_gap_bound.title: No bound is set on the time between the two days

RUL-neighbour_day_offset_drift_checked.content:
An offset proposed from a neighbouring day SHALL be asked about once, as a guessed offset is: at the check against the
tracks where tracks lie by the day's photos, and by acceptance where none do.
RUL-neighbour_day_offset_drift_checked.title: A neighbouring day's offset is asked about once

RUL-neighbour_day_offset_needs_acceptanc.content:
An offset proposed from a neighbouring day SHALL NOT take effect until the user accepts it — a confirmation of it
against the tracks counting as its acceptance.
RUL-neighbour_day_offset_needs_acceptanc.title: A neighbouring day's offset waits for the user's acceptance

RUL-neighbour_day_offset_proposed.content:
A camera's day in a destination with no anchor of its own, and no offset from the same day elsewhere, SHALL be proposed
the offset of the day before or after of the same camera in the same destination, where that day's offset was anchored
by the camera's own GPS.
RUL-neighbour_day_offset_proposed.title: A day with no anchor is offered the day next to it

RUL-new_file_restales_plan.content:
A file found, at execution, anywhere prep scans that its plan did not record SHALL make the plan stale, refused before
any change.
RUL-new_file_restales_plan.title: A file that appeared since planning restales the plan

RUL-no_library_only_snapshot.content: Merge SHALL take no snapshot of the library alone.
RUL-no_library_only_snapshot.title: Merge takes no snapshot of the library alone

RUL-no_links.content:
A symbolic link anywhere among the managed files SHALL block, never skipped silently: a link to a file anywhere; a
link to a folder inside a dump or a managed folder; a managed folder that is itself a link; a link at the top level.
RUL-no_links.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_links.title: No symbolic link is followed, and any link blocks

RUL-no_log_entry_for_other.content: A file of no media class SHALL have no entry in the log.
RUL-no_log_entry_for_other.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-no_log_entry_for_other.title: A file of no media class has no log entry

RUL-no_meaning_from_names.content: No phase SHALL read meaning from a file's name: its timestamp comes from its metadata.
RUL-no_meaning_from_names.title: No meaning is read from a file's name

RUL-no_op_run.content: A phase run over a workspace whose relevant state has not changed SHALL change nothing.
RUL-no_op_run.title: A run over unchanged inputs changes nothing

RUL-no_op_run_reports_reuse.content:
A run over unchanged inputs SHALL report the work it reused and the files already right, never treating earlier work as
an error.
RUL-no_op_run_reports_reuse.title: A run over unchanged inputs reports what it reused, never an error

RUL-no_op_run_same_result.content:
A phase run over a workspace whose relevant state has not changed SHALL produce the same result — the same operations,
fingerprints and names.
RUL-no_op_run_same_result.title: A run over unchanged inputs produces the same result

RUL-no_plan_location_option.content: No command SHALL take an option saying where to put a plan or where to find one; the fixed place is the contract.
RUL-no_plan_location_option.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_plan_location_option.title: No command is told where a plan is

RUL-no_plan_no_run.content: A dry run or an execution that finds no plan in its place SHALL stop.
RUL-no_plan_no_run.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_plan_no_run.title: No plan, no dry run and no execution

RUL-no_plan_says_plan_first.content: A dry run or an execution stopped for want of a plan SHALL tell the user to plan first.
RUL-no_plan_says_plan_first.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-no_plan_says_plan_first.title: The user is told to plan first

RUL-no_plan_while_a_decision_waits.content: Geotag SHALL make no executable plan while a decision waits for the user or a photo is not placed.
RUL-no_plan_while_a_decision_waits.title: No plan while anything waits

RUL-no_record_before_decisions.content: A geotag plan stopped before its first decision stage SHALL write no record of its own.
RUL-no_record_before_decisions.title: No record before the first decision stage

RUL-no_row_for_gone_file.content: A prep execution SHALL leave in the workspace database no row for a file that is gone.
RUL-no_row_for_gone_file.title: The database holds no row for a file that is gone

RUL-no_timezone_to_inherit_waits.content:
A destination with no timezone to inherit SHALL wait for the user, save one its photos give within its country
({need}`RUL-zone_from_photos_in_country`).
RUL-no_timezone_to_inherit_waits.title: A destination with no timezone to inherit waits

RUL-no_tracks_no_stop.content: Geotag SHALL proceed where no tracks folder is configured or the folder holds no track, each decision resting on its other sources.
RUL-no_tracks_no_stop.title: Geotag runs without tracks

RUL-not_inventoried.content:
Prep SHALL leave out of its inventory of media, each as a whole: the control records' place, the quarantine, a
version-control directory, and the strays folder with everything in it; and every hidden file.
RUL-not_inventoried.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-not_inventoried.title: What prep never inventories

RUL-not_local_named.content: The report of a workspace not on a local filesystem SHALL name the filesystem's type, where it can be told.
RUL-not_local_named.title: The stop names the filesystem's type

RUL-not_local_stops.content:
A workspace whose filesystem is not known to be local — one of another kind, or on a system whose filesystems cannot
be told — SHALL stop the run with nothing changed.
RUL-not_local_stops.title: A filesystem not known to be local stops the run

RUL-nothing_built_from_merge_records.content:
Nothing SHALL be built from the records a finished merge leaves — its summary, its log, its database image and its
package. Merge's plan and journal, from which an interrupted merge resumes, are not among these.
RUL-nothing_built_from_merge_records.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-nothing_built_from_merge_records.title: Nothing is built from a finished merge's records

RUL-null_island_is_no_position.content:
A photo whose position is latitude 0 and longitude 0 SHALL count, wherever geotag judges a photo's own position, as
having none.
RUL-null_island_is_no_position.title: A position at latitude 0 and longitude 0 is none

RUL-offset_far_from_evidence_asks.content:
A clock offset proposed from the destination's timezone, or from the offset a camera's photos record, SHALL NOT take
effect without an offset the user writes where it would put every photo of its day farther than the largest clock
error the configuration allows from every track point and from the true time of every photo of the destination taken
by another device whose true time is known, at least one such photo being there.
RUL-offset_far_from_evidence_asks.title: A guessed offset that puts the photos where nothing else was is not taken on acceptance

RUL-offset_from_own_evidence.content:
Each offset SHALL be proposed only from that camera's own positions on that day — in that destination, else in
another ({need}`RUL-offset_shared_within_day`) — or from the offset its photos there record with their times
({need}`RUL-recorded_offset_proposed`), or from the destination's timezone; never from another day's offset — save the
one its own GPS gave the day before or after, as {need}`RUL-neighbour_day_offset_proposed` proposes it — nor from one
the user wrote or accepted on a guess in another destination.
RUL-offset_from_own_evidence.title: An offset is proposed from its own evidence only

RUL-offset_per_camera_destination_day.content:
Geotag SHALL decide a camera's clock offset once for each destination and each day it took photos there, by the
camera's own clock — a container destination, holding no photo, having none.
RUL-offset_per_camera_destination_day.title: One clock offset per camera, destination and day

RUL-offset_shared_within_day.content:
A camera's photos of a day in a destination where none has its own position SHALL be proposed the offset the camera's
own positions gave that day in another destination, in place of the one their times record and the timezone's.
RUL-offset_shared_within_day.title: A day's offset is the camera's wherever its photos were sorted

RUL-offset_within_time_value.content: An offset written within the value of a time field itself SHALL count as the offset recorded with that time.
RUL-offset_within_time_value.title: An offset inside the time's own value is recorded with it

RUL-offset_within_value_before_beside.content: An offset written within a time's value SHALL be taken before one in a field beside it.
RUL-offset_within_value_before_beside.title: An offset inside the value comes before one beside it

RUL-one_configuration.content:
All three phases SHALL read their settings from the workspace's one configuration alone, each the settings it needs — no
phase keeping settings of its own, and no setting that bears on what a run produces coming from outside the workspace.
What a new workspace's configuration starts as is seeded into it once ({need}`RUL-config_seeded_once`) and read from
there after.
RUL-one_configuration.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-one_configuration.title: One configuration, read by every phase

RUL-one_database.content: A workspace SHALL hold exactly one database of record.
RUL-one_database.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-one_database.title: One database, in the workspace

RUL-one_editor_at_a_time.content: A workspace SHALL be open in at most one decision editor at a time, another being refused while it is.
RUL-one_editor_at_a_time.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-one_editor_at_a_time.title: One decision editor at a time

RUL-one_filename_format.content: Prep and geotag SHALL name files from a timestamp in one format for the whole pipeline, not one for each phase.
RUL-one_filename_format.title: One format, set by the configuration

RUL-one_filesystem_checked_every_run.content:
Every run of every phase on a workspace SHALL check, before it reads or changes anything but the lock and the seal,
that the workspace lies on one filesystem — never taking it as whole because an earlier run found it so.
RUL-one_filesystem_checked_every_run.title: The workspace's filesystem is checked each run

RUL-one_photo_failure_contained.content: A photo whose planned changes cannot be made SHALL fail alone: every other photo's result is still recorded.
RUL-one_photo_failure_contained.title: One photo's failure is its own

RUL-one_workspace_lock.content: A workspace SHALL have exactly one lock, shared by every command.
RUL-one_workspace_lock.title: A workspace has one lock

RUL-only_corrected_time_marked.content: Geotag SHALL NOT record in a photo that its time was corrected unless the time is corrected.
RUL-only_corrected_time_marked.title: Only a corrected time is marked

RUL-only_duplicates_recorded_as_duplicat.content:
A file prep quarantines for another reason than being a copy — a leftover of an interrupted write, a hidden file of a
dump — SHALL be recorded as no duplicate: neither in its summary, nor its handoff, nor its log.
RUL-only_duplicates_recorded_as_duplicat.section_name: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
sections: 10. Duplicates and failures beside photos by destination
RUL-only_duplicates_recorded_as_duplicat.title: Only a duplicate is recorded as one

RUL-only_prep_builds_structure.content:
No phase but prep SHALL create or repair the workspace's structure; the folders merge creates in the library are
placement, not structure.
RUL-only_prep_builds_structure.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-only_prep_builds_structure.title: No other phase creates or repairs the structure

RUL-operations_atomic.content:
A move, a rename or a placement SHALL be one indivisible operation where the filesystem allows, so that an interruption
leaves the state before it or the state after, never part of either.
RUL-operations_atomic.title: An interrupted move leaves the before or the after

RUL-organization_settings_restale.content:
A change to the managed folders' names, or to which extensions are which class of media, SHALL make stale geotag's
executable plan and merge's plan.
RUL-organization_settings_restale.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-organization_settings_restale.title: A change to the folder names or the media classes restales the plans

RUL-other_capture_times_corrected.content:
Geotag SHALL write each photo's true time, as its destination's local time, also into every other field in which the
photo already records when it was made, adding none it does not hold.
RUL-other_capture_times_corrected.title: Every field recording the making holds the corrected time

RUL-other_databases_scratch.content:
Any database a phase keeps besides the database of record SHALL be scratch: holding no decision and no history, safe
to delete at any time.
RUL-other_databases_scratch.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-other_databases_scratch.title: Any other database is scratch

RUL-other_outside_inbox_blocks.content: A file of no media class found in a managed folder other than the inbox SHALL block prep's plan.
RUL-other_outside_inbox_blocks.section_name: 5. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 5. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-other_outside_inbox_blocks.title: A file of no media class outside the inbox blocks prep

RUL-own_position_kept.content:
Geotag SHALL never replace a photo's own GPS position — save on the user's answer, where its camera's agreed clock
offset contradicts it ({need}`RUL-own_position_replaced_on_answer`).
RUL-own_position_kept.title: A photo's own position is kept

RUL-own_position_replaced_on_answer.content:
A photo's own GPS position SHALL be replaced only by a position the user sets for it, and only where its camera's
clock offset, agreed from its own GPS, contradicts that position.
RUL-own_position_replaced_on_answer.title: An own position the agreed offset contradicts is replaced only on the user's answer

RUL-own_values_follow_new_fingerprint.content:
A photo whose fingerprint is taken again with a new value SHALL keep the own values geotag pinned for it under the old
one, so long as the change maps one value to one.
RUL-own_values_follow_new_fingerprint.title: A photo's own values follow its fingerprint's new value

RUL-package_contents.content:
The archival package SHALL hold every control record but the transient ones, archived together with its own list of
them: the configuration that governed the workspace; every current decision and plan record, exactly as the pipeline
validated it; the database, with its snapshot from the end of each phase; every phase's transformation log; and every
run's journal.
RUL-package_contents.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-package_contents.title: What the package holds

RUL-package_lists_contents.content: The package SHALL list its contents with each item's hash, so its integrity can be checked later.
RUL-package_lists_contents.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-package_lists_contents.title: The package lists its contents with their hashes

RUL-package_self_describing.content: The package SHALL say which workspace it came from and which plan and execution it records.
RUL-package_self_describing.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-package_self_describing.title: The package describes itself

RUL-pair_named_as_one.content:
Photos of a destination that share a name, extension aside, and take new names of one timestamp SHALL be given one new
name, each keeping its extension, that no other photo there holds under any extension.
RUL-pair_named_as_one.title: A pair takes one name

RUL-partial_history_shown.content:
A phase whose kept history cannot rebuild a photo's journey through it SHALL fail, or mark its record plainly partial —
never writing a log that looks whole but reflects only the last run.
RUL-partial_history_shown.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-partial_history_shown.title: A history too thin to rebuild is never shown as whole

RUL-phase_writes_own_records.content:
Each numbered record SHALL be written by the phase whose number it carries, and by no other: a phase MAY create, rewrite
or extend its own records across its runs, and reads every other phase's records read-only.
RUL-phase_writes_own_records.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-phase_writes_own_records.title: Each phase writes only its own records

RUL-phone_agreeing_anchor_changes_nothin.content:
A phone's photos SHALL be read as they are without their own GPS, nothing asked, where the offset that GPS gives agrees,
within the tolerance the configuration allows an accepted offset, with the one each of the photos giving it is read by.
RUL-phone_agreeing_anchor_changes_nothin.section_name: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
sections: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
RUL-phone_agreeing_anchor_changes_nothin.title: A phone whose own GPS agrees is read as before

RUL-phone_anchored_like_camera.content:
A phone's photos holding their own position SHALL anchor the phone's clock for each destination and day on the tracks
as a camera's photos do, by the same settings.
RUL-phone_anchored_like_camera.section_name: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
sections: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
RUL-phone_anchored_like_camera.title: A phone's photos are anchored as a camera's are

RUL-phone_disagreeing_anchors_apply.content:
An offset two or more of a phone's photos of a destination and day give from their own GPS, agreeing among themselves
and disagreeing with the one they are read by, SHALL take effect for every photo of the phone's day there as a camera's
several anchors do.
RUL-phone_disagreeing_anchors_apply.section_name: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
sections: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
RUL-phone_disagreeing_anchors_apply.title: Several of a phone's photos disagreeing apply what they agree on

RUL-phone_kept_as_recorded.content:
A phone's day the user keeps as its photos record themselves SHALL be read as it is without its own GPS, while that GPS
gives another offset.
RUL-phone_kept_as_recorded.section_name: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
sections: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
RUL-phone_kept_as_recorded.title: A phone kept as it records itself

RUL-phone_single_anchor_proposed.content:
An offset one of a phone's photos gives from its own GPS, disagreeing with the one it is read by, SHALL NOT take effect
until the user accepts it.
RUL-phone_single_anchor_proposed.section_name: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
sections: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
RUL-phone_single_anchor_proposed.title: One phone photo disagreeing is a proposal

RUL-phone_time_from_own_offset.content:
A phone's photo SHALL take its true time from the offset recorded with the time it was read from, else from its
destination's timezone as {need}`RUL-untagged_phone_photo_read_as_siblings` allows — save where its own GPS reads the
phone's clock otherwise ({need}`RUL-phone_disagreeing_anchors_apply`).
RUL-phone_time_from_own_offset.title: A phone's time is read by the offset recorded with it

RUL-photo_decision_follows_the_photo.content: A decision made for one photo SHALL stay that photo's when geotag renames it or its fingerprint is taken again.
RUL-photo_decision_follows_the_photo.title: A photo's decision follows the photo

RUL-photo_decision_never_passes_by_name.content: A decision made for one photo SHALL never pass to another photo that takes its name.
RUL-photo_decision_never_passes_by_name.title: A photo's decision never passes with its name

RUL-photos_by_date.content: Prep SHALL put each photo it takes in that has a recorded time into photos by date, under its timestamp name.
RUL-photos_by_date.title: Prep puts photos by date

RUL-placed_bytes_confirm_place.content:
A library place an earlier execute recorded filling SHALL count as holding its photo while it holds the very bytes
placed there, whatever ImageMagick version now takes the fingerprints.
RUL-placed_bytes_confirm_place.title: An earlier place is confirmed by the bytes placed there

RUL-placement_order.content:
A photo with no position of its own SHALL be placed by the first that applies: a position the user set for it, the
tracks at its resolved time, its destination's folder fallback.
RUL-placement_order.title: A photo is placed by the most specific source it has

RUL-placement_recorded_with_its_track.content:
A position the tracks give a photo SHALL be recorded in the workspace's record with the track that gave it and the
time it was placed at.
RUL-placement_recorded_with_its_track.title: A position from the tracks is recorded with its track

RUL-plan_at_fixed_place.content:
Each phase's plan, and each of its decision records, SHALL have one fixed place among the control records, where the
phase's planning writes it and its dry run and its execution read it.
RUL-plan_at_fixed_place.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-plan_at_fixed_place.title: Each plan has one fixed place

RUL-plan_carried_out_by_its_code.content:
Each phase SHALL carry out or summarise a saved plan only with the code that made it, refusing before any change a plan
made by other code or recording none.
RUL-plan_carried_out_by_its_code.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-plan_carried_out_by_its_code.title: A plan is carried out only by the code that made it

RUL-plan_counts_placement.content: The executable plan SHALL count its photos by how each comes by its position — its own, each way the tracks or the user give one.
RUL-plan_counts_placement.title: The plan counts how every photo is placed

RUL-plan_memo_kept.content:
Prep's planning SHALL keep in the plan memo the fingerprint and metadata of each media file it read, for a later plan
to reuse.
RUL-plan_memo_kept.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-plan_memo_kept.title: A plan keeps what it read

RUL-planning_changes_no_media.content: Planning SHALL change no media file.
RUL-planning_changes_no_media.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
