sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-planning_changes_no_media.title: Planning changes no media

RUL-planning_leaves_record.content: No plan, dry run or finalize SHALL change the recorded state of the workspace's files.
RUL-planning_leaves_record.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-planning_leaves_record.title: Planning leaves the recorded state as it was

RUL-planning_writes_only_its_records.content:
Planning SHALL write nothing but its plan, its decision records, what it keeps so that later runs need not compute it
again, the changes to the workspace the user accepts ({need}`RUL-acceptance_recorded`), the user's answer to whether to
download the table of countries with the table downloaded ({need}`RUL-zone_table_asked_once`), and — on a workspace's
first run — the configuration it seeds.
RUL-planning_writes_only_its_records.section_name: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
sections: 16. Nothing changed outside a validated plan
RUL-planning_writes_only_its_records.title: Planning writes only its own records

RUL-position_carries_its_method.content: Every position geotag writes SHALL say, in the photo itself, how it was found: on a track point, between two, past a track's end, set for the photo, or its folder's fallback.
RUL-position_carries_its_method.title: A position says how it was found

RUL-position_cleared_whole.content: A position geotag clears SHALL be cleared whole.
RUL-position_cleared_whole.title: A position is cleared whole

RUL-position_written_whole.content: A position geotag writes SHALL be written whole — every part of the position together.
RUL-position_written_whole.title: A position is written whole

RUL-prep_derives_camera_group.content: Prep SHALL derive each file's camera group from its device-identity metadata.
RUL-prep_derives_camera_group.title: Prep derives the camera group

RUL-prep_dry_run_changes_nothing.content: Prep's dry run SHALL change nothing in the workspace.
RUL-prep_dry_run_changes_nothing.title: A dry run changes nothing

RUL-prep_empties_inbox.content: A prep execution SHALL leave the inbox empty.
RUL-prep_empties_inbox.title: Prep leaves the inbox empty

RUL-prep_journal_kept.content:
A prep execution of a plan already executed SHALL never overwrite the earlier attempt's journal: it is first set aside,
recoverably.
RUL-prep_journal_kept.title: A plan executed again keeps the earlier attempt's journal

RUL-prep_leaves_by_dest_as_found.content:
Prep SHALL leave photos by destination as it finds it: never moving a file into it, out of it or within it, nor
renaming, quarantining, deleting or writing one there.
RUL-prep_leaves_by_dest_as_found.section_name: 1. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
sections: 1. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
RUL-prep_leaves_by_dest_as_found.title: Prep leaves photos by destination as it finds it

RUL-prep_log_derived.content:
Prep's log SHALL be made from prep's plans, journals, quarantine evidence and database alone, holding nothing they do
not.
RUL-prep_log_derived.title: Prep's log is made from prep's own records

RUL-prep_log_records_set_aside.content:
Prep's log SHALL record each duplicate prep quarantined — where it was, where it went, and the copy kept — with the kept
copy's entry.
RUL-prep_log_records_set_aside.title: Prep's log names what it set aside

RUL-prep_name_provisional.content:
Prep SHALL derive a file's name from its raw timestamp, as the camera recorded it, for organizing and ordering only — a
provisional name, which prep never corrects, resolves to a timezone or converts to UTC.
RUL-prep_name_provisional.title: Prep's name is provisional

RUL-prep_no_time_or_gps.content: Prep SHALL make no correction to a file's time or position: it plans, infers, writes and applies none.
RUL-prep_no_time_or_gps.section_name: 1. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
sections: 1. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
RUL-prep_no_time_or_gps.title: Prep corrects no time and no position

RUL-prep_records_on_success.content: Prep SHALL write its log and its handoff only at the end of an execution all of whose operations succeeded.
RUL-prep_records_on_success.title: Prep's records are written only by an execution that succeeded

RUL-prep_records_sort.content: Geotag SHALL NOT plan while photos by destination holds a photo prep has not recorded where it now is.
RUL-prep_records_sort.title: Geotag does not plan over an unrecorded sort

RUL-prep_records_written_whole.content: Prep's log and its handoff SHALL each be written whole, never edited in place.
RUL-prep_records_written_whole.title: Prep's records are written whole

RUL-prep_refresh_not_a_change.content: A refresh that changes only what describes a prep run SHALL NOT count, for merge, as a change since finalize.
RUL-prep_refresh_not_a_change.title: A refresh describing only a prep run is not a change

RUL-prep_replans.content:
After an interrupted execution, prep SHALL plan again from the workspace as it stands, never resuming or replaying the
interrupted plan.
RUL-prep_replans.title: An interrupted execution is planned again, not resumed

RUL-prep_run_summarised.content:
With each plan, and again at the end of its execution, prep SHALL report a summary telling what it changes apart from
what it only reads: its media
operations, the files already in place, the moves it recognized, the files of photos by destination it read, the
duplicates of files it may change apart from those of photos by destination, the metadata reused, extracted, carried
and failed, the blockers and warnings, and which records it wrote.
RUL-prep_run_summarised.title: Prep's run is summarised

RUL-prep_takes_no_decision.content: Prep SHALL ask the user for no decision, organizing from the state of the workspace and its configuration alone.
RUL-prep_takes_no_decision.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-prep_takes_no_decision.title: Prep takes no decision

RUL-prepped_nothing_to_do.content:
On an initialized workspace whose inbox holds nothing — no file, and no folder — and where nothing the user moved,
removed or changed since the last run waits to be recorded, prep's dry run and execution SHALL stop, changing nothing,
and not carry out the saved plan.
RUL-prepped_nothing_to_do.title: A prepped workspace has nothing to do

RUL-proposals_need_acceptance.content:
A proposal geotag makes SHALL take effect only once the user accepts it, save one a rule says takes effect without the
user's answer. A clock offset derived from the destination's timezone, or from the offset a camera's photos record with
their times, is such a proposal.
RUL-proposals_need_acceptance.title: A proposal waits for the user's acceptance

RUL-prune_age_at_least_one_day.content: Pruning the quarantine by age SHALL refuse an age of less than one day.
RUL-prune_age_at_least_one_day.title: An age to prune by is at least a day

RUL-prune_explicit.content: Prep SHALL delete quarantined files only by its prune command.
RUL-prune_explicit.title: Only the user's prune deletes, and only when told to

RUL-prune_lists_unless_told.content: Prep's prune command SHALL list what it would delete, deleting nothing, unless told to delete.
RUL-prune_lists_unless_told.title: The prune lists what it would delete unless told to delete

RUL-prune_only_quarantine.content:
Prep's prune command SHALL touch nothing outside the quarantine but its own record of what it deletes
({need}`RUL-prune_recorded`).
RUL-prune_only_quarantine.title: The prune touches nothing outside the quarantine

RUL-prune_record_kept.content: A prune's record SHALL never be written over by a later prune's: the earlier is set aside, recoverably.
RUL-prune_record_kept.title: An earlier prune's record is kept

RUL-prune_recorded.content:
Prep's prune command, told to delete, SHALL record among the control records what it deletes and when, before it
deletes it.
RUL-prune_recorded.title: A prune that deletes is recorded

RUL-quarantine_changed_only_by_prune.content: What a prune removes from the quarantine SHALL be no difference to the next comparison.
RUL-quarantine_changed_only_by_prune.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-quarantine_changed_only_by_prune.title: The quarantine changes only by prune

RUL-quarantine_footprint_reported.content:
Each prep plan SHALL report the quarantine's size — its files, their bytes, and the runs that filled it, oldest and
newest.
RUL-quarantine_footprint_reported.title: The quarantine's size is reported

RUL-quarantine_never_auto_deleted.content: No prep run SHALL remove anything from the quarantine, however often it runs and however old the quarantine is.
RUL-quarantine_never_auto_deleted.title: No run deletes from the quarantine

RUL-quarantined_leaves_database.content: A file prep has quarantined SHALL NOT be in the workspace database.
RUL-quarantined_leaves_database.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-quarantined_leaves_database.title: A quarantined file leaves the database

RUL-quarantined_leaves_handoff.content: A file prep has quarantined SHALL NOT be in the handoff.
RUL-quarantined_leaves_handoff.section_name: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
sections: 9. Files the user moves, and the plan memo
RUL-quarantined_leaves_handoff.title: A quarantined file leaves the handoff

RUL-ranked_folder_missing_told.content: The user SHALL be told of each folder the configuration ranks that the tracks do not hold.
RUL-ranked_folder_missing_told.title: A ranked folder the tracks lack is told

RUL-record_in_place_while_replaced.content: A plan or decision record being replaced SHALL be at its path at every instant — the earlier version until the new one is whole — so that a run killed in between finds the decisions, never an empty place.
RUL-record_in_place_while_replaced.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-record_in_place_while_replaced.title: A record being replaced never leaves its path

RUL-record_needed.content: Geotag and merge SHALL refuse a workspace whose state no execution has recorded.
RUL-record_needed.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-record_needed.title: Geotag and merge need a recorded state

RUL-record_whole_each_phase.content:
At the end of every phase the workspace SHALL hold a complete, self-sufficient, human-readable record of everything done
to its files so far: whole whether or not any later phase ever runs, extended by each phase through its own work, a
phase not yet run reading as the workspace not having advanced, never as a record incomplete.
RUL-record_whole_each_phase.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-record_whole_each_phase.title: The record is whole at the end of every phase

RUL-recorded_offset_proposed.content:
A camera's photos of a day in a destination where none has its own position, and where every one of them recording an
offset with its time records the same one, SHALL be proposed the clock offset of a clock set to that offset, in place
of the timezone's.
RUL-recorded_offset_proposed.title: A camera's offset is proposed from the offset its photos record

RUL-recorded_time_order.content:
A file's recorded time SHALL be read from the first of its `DateTimeOriginal`, `CreateDate` and `ModifyDate` that
holds a valid time; a field present but holding none is passed over.
RUL-recorded_time_order.title: Which field is the recorded time

RUL-records_written_alike.content:
A record that another record or a later run depends on SHALL be written as the same bytes whenever its content is the
same, so that its hash changes only when what it says does.
RUL-records_written_alike.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-records_written_alike.title: The same content is written as the same bytes

RUL-redundant_jpeg_only.content:
Prep SHALL move into redundant JPEGs no file but a JPEG in the inbox that shares its folder and its name, extension
aside, with a raw file.
RUL-redundant_jpeg_only.title: Only a JPEG beside its RAW is set aside

RUL-redundant_jpeg_set_aside.content:
Prep SHALL move into redundant JPEGs each JPEG in the inbox that shares its folder and its name, extension aside, with
a raw file.
RUL-redundant_jpeg_set_aside.title: A JPEG beside its RAW is set aside

RUL-redundant_jpg_timestamp_named.content:
A JPG prep sets aside as redundant to its RAW SHALL get its timestamp name, or with no recorded time its untimed name,
as any file prep files does.
RUL-redundant_jpg_timestamp_named.title: A redundant JPG gets its timestamp name

RUL-rehash_explained.content: Each prep plan SHALL report how many media files it fingerprinted again, and why — deciding nothing by it.
RUL-rehash_explained.section_name: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-rehash_explained.title: A fingerprint taken again is explained

RUL-rehash_memo_count_reported.content: Each prep plan SHALL report how many fingerprints it took from the plan memo.
RUL-rehash_memo_count_reported.section_name: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-rehash_memo_count_reported.title: A plan reports the fingerprints it took from the memo

RUL-remake_only_what_depends.content: When an input changes, only the records that depend on it SHALL be made again, every other record left as it is.
RUL-remake_only_what_depends.title: Only what depends on a change is made again

RUL-rename_held_with_write.content: A photo's rename SHALL be held back while a write to it is not counted as done.
RUL-rename_held_with_write.title: A held write holds the rename back

RUL-repeated_gps_time_not_counted.content:
The GPS times of a camera's photos of a day in a destination SHALL NOT be counted as evidence of its clock where two of
them record the same GPS time at different camera times, or where their differences from the camera times lie farther
apart than the configuration lets anchors agree.
RUL-repeated_gps_time_not_counted.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-repeated_gps_time_not_counted.title: A GPS time that repeats, or that disagrees, is not counted

RUL-repeated_time_answered_by_a_reading.content: An answer for a local time its timezone repeats SHALL take effect only as one of the time's two readings.
RUL-repeated_time_answered_by_a_reading.title: A time shown twice is answered by one of its readings

RUL-repeated_write_failure_way_out.content:
A photo whose metadata write fails in an execution as it failed in the previous execution of the same plan — the same
operations, the same reason — SHALL be reported so, in the run's output and its record, with the way out: moving it
back into photos by date, then running prep and planning geotag again.
RUL-repeated_write_failure_way_out.title: A write failing again the same way names the way out

RUL-replaced_own_position_logged.content:
A photo's own position replaced on the user's answer SHALL be recorded in the workspace's record with the position it
replaced.
RUL-replaced_own_position_logged.title: A replaced own position is logged with what it replaced

RUL-replan_block_names_why.content: The blocker for a photo a fresh plan cannot carry forward SHALL name why.
RUL-replan_block_names_why.title: The blocker for a photo not carried names why

RUL-replan_blocks_unaccounted.content: A finalized photo no longer in photos by destination that a fresh plan cannot carry forward SHALL block.
RUL-replan_blocks_unaccounted.title: A photo a fresh plan cannot carry blocks

RUL-replan_carries_placed.content:
A fresh plan SHALL carry forward every finalized photo no longer in photos by destination with the library place the
latest earlier plan of the workspace gave it whose place, checked again, holds it — whether or not the journal
recorded the move.
RUL-replan_carries_placed.title: A fresh plan carries the photos earlier plans placed

RUL-replanning_keeps_the_prior.content:
Re-planning SHALL never overwrite a plan or a decision record: when what it makes differs from what is saved, the
saved one is first set aside, recoverably.
RUL-replanning_keeps_the_prior.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-replanning_keeps_the_prior.title: Re-planning sets the prior plan aside

RUL-required_snapshot_or_nothing.content: When the configuration requires snapshots, a run that cannot take one SHALL stop before it changes anything.
RUL-required_snapshot_or_nothing.title: A required snapshot that fails stops the run

RUL-reread_whole.content:
A media file whose metadata prep reads again — the way metadata is read having changed — SHALL be fingerprinted again
with it.
RUL-reread_whole.title: A file read again is read whole

RUL-rerun_asks_only_affected.content: A re-run SHALL ask for new decisions only for the items the change affects.
RUL-rerun_asks_only_affected.title: A re-run asks only about what the change affects

RUL-rerun_does_what_changed.content:
A re-run SHALL redo exactly the work its changed inputs require — new media, an edited setting, changed tracks, a
withdrawn or altered decision, a refreshed handoff — and no more.
RUL-rerun_does_what_changed.title: A re-run does as much as what changed requires

RUL-rerun_rederives_written_position.content: A geotag re-run SHALL derive again and replace a position geotag wrote, never keeping it as the file's own.
RUL-rerun_rederives_written_position.title: A re-run derives again a position geotag wrote

RUL-reseal_rederives_nothing.content: Merge SHALL remake the package from the records as they stand, re-deriving nothing of an earlier phase.
RUL-reseal_rederives_nothing.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-reseal_rederives_nothing.title: Remaking the package re-derives nothing

RUL-restored_file_is_new.content: A file the user moves from the quarantine back into the inbox SHALL be handled as a new file of the dump.
RUL-restored_file_is_new.title: A file restored from the quarantine is a new file

RUL-restored_file_record_kept.content: The earlier quarantine record of a file the user moves back into the inbox SHALL be left as it is.
RUL-restored_file_record_kept.title: A restored file's quarantine record is left as it is

RUL-resume_block_makes_partial.content: A run in which a photo gone from photos by destination blocks SHALL be partial.
RUL-resume_block_makes_partial.title: A run with a photo gone from both places is partial

RUL-resume_blocks_missing.content: A photo gone from photos by destination whose library place does not hold it SHALL block.
RUL-resume_blocks_missing.title: A photo gone from both places blocks

RUL-resume_rechecks_library.content:
A photo gone from photos by destination SHALL count as merged only while its library place, checked again, holds
it — whatever the journal or the plan says.
RUL-resume_rechecks_library.title: A resumed merge checks the library, not the journal

RUL-retake_only_unchanged_file.content:
A fingerprint SHALL count as taken again only for a file unchanged since the last execution — its size, modification
time and file identity those recorded — whose fingerprint was taken by another method; a different file at the path is
a new photo, and the gone photo's entry stays as it was.
RUL-retake_only_unchanged_file.title: Only the same file, unchanged, has its fingerprint taken again

RUL-retaken_fingerprint_same_photo.content:
A fingerprint taken again under another ImageMagick version whose value is new SHALL be read as the same photo's —
never, for a changed version alone, as a different photo's.
RUL-retaken_fingerprint_same_photo.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-retaken_fingerprint_same_photo.title: A fingerprint taken again is the same photo's

RUL-retaken_fingerprint_step_logged.content: The log SHALL record a step for the change when a photo's fingerprint is taken again with a new value.
RUL-retaken_fingerprint_step_logged.title: A fingerprint taken again is a step in the log

RUL-reuse_valid_work.content:
Work already done and still valid SHALL be reused, not repeated — a file's content and metadata read, and the tracks
parsed, only for inputs that are new or have changed.
RUL-reuse_valid_work.title: Valid work is reused

RUL-revisit_matched_to_its_day.content:
Photos of a place the tracks passed on several visits — the same destination on consecutive days, a place passed
morning and evening — SHALL anchor their camera's clock by the visit the camera's photos agree on, never by another
visit's track because it passed closer.
RUL-revisit_matched_to_its_day.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-revisit_matched_to_its_day.title: A place visited on several days is matched to the photo's day

RUL-rewrite_in_place_atomic.content:
A write that rewrites a file in place SHALL leave, if interrupted — the run stopped or killed, or the power lost — the
intact original or the fully written file, never a damaged one between them.
RUL-rewrite_in_place_atomic.title: A file rewritten in place is the old one or the new one

RUL-run_only_refresh_restales_nothing.content:
A rewrite of the handoff that changes only what describes the run, not its content, SHALL NOT make anything downstream
stale.
RUL-run_only_refresh_restales_nothing.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-run_only_refresh_restales_nothing.title: Refreshing what describes the run restales nothing

RUL-same_day_offsets_agree.content:
Two offsets a camera's own positions gave on one day in different destinations, farther apart than the configuration
allows, SHALL NOT take effect until the user writes which is right.
RUL-same_day_offsets_agree.title: One clock is not read two ways in one day

RUL-same_pixels_other_file_blocks.content: A photo whose picture the library already holds in a file of other bytes — the same pixels, other metadata — SHALL be blocked, both files named and neither removed, for the user to settle.
RUL-same_pixels_other_file_blocks.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-same_pixels_other_file_blocks.title: The same picture in another file blocks

RUL-save_keeps_the_replaced.content:
The decision editor's save SHALL NOT overwrite a record it answers into: each one whose content it changes is first set
aside, recoverably, among the earlier versions a re-plan sets aside — the configuration excepted.
RUL-save_keeps_the_replaced.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-save_keeps_the_replaced.title: A save keeps the record it replaces

RUL-save_only_what_was_shown.content: The decision editor SHALL NOT save while a decision record is not the one it loaded, or while an edit names a decision the record does not hold.
RUL-save_only_what_was_shown.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-save_only_what_was_shown.title: The editor saves only over what it showed

RUL-save_writes_in_order.content:
The decision editor SHALL write the records a save changes one after another, each whole, in the order each stands on
the one before — the time decisions, the drift validation, the GPS decisions, then the execution's summary, and the
configuration last — so that a save cut short leaves only a leading part of it written.
RUL-save_writes_in_order.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-save_writes_in_order.title: A save writes its records in the order they stand on each other

RUL-scratch_database_not_archived.content: A scratch database SHALL NOT be archived.
RUL-scratch_database_not_archived.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-scratch_database_not_archived.title: A scratch database is not archived

RUL-scratch_database_not_journalled.content: A scratch database SHALL NOT be journalled.
RUL-scratch_database_not_journalled.section_name: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
sections: 12. The record of what was done, kept beyond the workspace
RUL-scratch_database_not_journalled.title: A scratch database is not journalled

RUL-seal_is_authority.content: Whether a workspace is finished SHALL be read from its seal alone, never from the state of its folders.
RUL-seal_is_authority.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-seal_is_authority.title: The seal alone says a workspace is finished

RUL-seal_on_success_only.content:
Merge SHALL seal the workspace only when it succeeds whole — every photo by destination placed in the library or found
already there, none left — a partial, failed or interrupted merge leaving it unsealed.
RUL-seal_on_success_only.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-seal_on_success_only.title: Only a whole merge seals

RUL-sealed_new_dump_left.content: A command refusing a sealed workspace SHALL leave a new dump it finds there exactly where it is.
RUL-sealed_new_dump_left.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_new_dump_left.title: A new dump in a sealed workspace is left where it is

RUL-sealed_new_dump_warned.content:
A command refusing a sealed workspace that finds anything where a dump would land — an entry at the workspace's top
level other than its managed folders and hidden entries, or anything in the inbox — SHALL say that a new dump is likely
there and must go to a fresh workspace.
RUL-sealed_new_dump_warned.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_new_dump_warned.title: A new dump in a sealed workspace is pointed out

RUL-sealed_no_library_recorded.content: Merge's library setup SHALL NOT record a library in a sealed workspace's configuration.
RUL-sealed_no_library_recorded.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_no_library_recorded.title: A sealed workspace's configuration records no library

RUL-sealed_prune_allowed.content: Pruning the quarantine SHALL remain allowed in a sealed workspace — the only change allowed there.
RUL-sealed_prune_allowed.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_prune_allowed.title: Pruning the quarantine is still allowed

RUL-sealed_refuses.content:
In a sealed workspace prep, geotag and merge SHALL stop as they start, changing nothing but the owner record of the
workspace lock. Its records MAY still be read.
RUL-sealed_refuses.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-sealed_refuses.title: A sealed workspace is never processed again

RUL-sealing_needs_no_tracks.content: Finalize SHALL proceed without the tracks folder, on the track points the workspace keeps.
RUL-sealing_needs_no_tracks.title: Finalize needs no tracks folder

RUL-set_aside_counted_by_reason.content:
Prep's summary SHALL count the files it quarantines by the reason for each — duplicates, leftovers of an interrupted
write, hidden files of a dump — apart.
RUL-set_aside_counted_by_reason.title: What prep quarantines is counted by why

RUL-set_aside_jpeg_catches_up.content:
Where a RAW in photos by destination that geotag changed on an earlier run holds a name the JPEG prep set aside beside
it does not, extension aside, geotag SHALL rename that JPEG to the RAW's name, extension aside.
RUL-set_aside_jpeg_catches_up.title: A JPEG left behind its RAW takes the RAW's name

RUL-set_aside_jpeg_named_as_raw.content: A JPEG set aside beside its RAW that carries that RAW's name, extension aside, SHALL NOT stop prep as misnamed.
RUL-set_aside_jpeg_named_as_raw.title: A set-aside JPEG may carry its RAW's name

RUL-set_aside_jpeg_only_renamed.content:
Geotag SHALL write nothing into a file outside photos by destination: a JPEG set aside beside its RAW is renamed, and
no tag is written to it.
RUL-set_aside_jpeg_only_renamed.title: A set-aside JPEG is renamed, never written

RUL-set_aside_jpeg_renamed_with_raw.content:
Where geotag renames a RAW in photos by destination, it SHALL rename the JPEG prep set aside beside that RAW to the
RAW's new name, extension aside — the one change geotag makes outside photos by destination.
RUL-set_aside_jpeg_renamed_with_raw.title: A JPEG set aside beside its RAW is renamed with it

RUL-set_aside_plan_reported.content: Re-planning that sets a saved plan or decision record aside SHALL tell the user where.
RUL-set_aside_plan_reported.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-set_aside_plan_reported.title: The user is told where the prior plan went

RUL-setting_bounds_one_thing.content: No setting of the configuration SHALL be read for more than one purpose.
RUL-setting_bounds_one_thing.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-setting_bounds_one_thing.title: A setting has one purpose

RUL-several_bodies_days_apart.content:
A day of a camera group the configuration names several bodies SHALL NOT take, nor be held against, the offset the
group's GPS gave that day in another destination: the bodies are told apart by the destinations their photos are
sorted into.
RUL-several_bodies_days_apart.title: The bodies' days in different destinations are decided apart

RUL-several_bodies_named_by_configuratio.content:
Geotag SHALL treat as several bodies of one camera exactly the camera groups the configuration names so, every other
group being one camera.
RUL-several_bodies_named_by_configuratio.title: The configuration says which camera groups are several bodies

RUL-several_bodies_no_clock_change_split.content: Geotag SHALL NOT propose splitting a day of a camera group the configuration names several bodies.
RUL-several_bodies_no_clock_change_split.title: Several bodies are never split at a change of the clock

RUL-several_bodies_noted.content:
A clock offset proposed from the GPS of a camera group the configuration names several bodies SHALL be recorded with
the note that the group may be several bodies.
RUL-several_bodies_noted.title: The proposal says the group may be several bodies

RUL-several_bodies_offset_never_auto.content:
A clock offset proposed from the GPS of a camera group the configuration names several bodies SHALL NOT take effect
without the user's answer.
RUL-several_bodies_offset_never_auto.title: An offset from the GPS of several bodies never applies itself

RUL-several_bodies_positions_not_doubted.content:
Geotag SHALL NOT read the photos of a camera group the configuration names several bodies that disagree with its clock
offset as holding wrong positions.
RUL-several_bodies_positions_not_doubted.title: The disagreeing photos of several bodies are not wrong positions

RUL-shape_checked_first.content:
Each phase SHALL check the workspace's shape at its start — right after the lock and the seal check, before it scans,
plans or changes anything.
RUL-shape_checked_first.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-shape_checked_first.title: The shape is checked first

RUL-shared_offset_auto_only_as_there.content: An offset proposed from another destination of the same day SHALL take effect by itself only where it did there.
RUL-shared_offset_auto_only_as_there.title: A shared offset applies itself only where it did there

RUL-sidecar_blocks.content:
An editing sidecar — a file holding a photo's development beside it — found anywhere prep inventories SHALL block
prep's plan.
RUL-sidecar_blocks.section_name: 5. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 5. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-sidecar_blocks.title: An editing sidecar blocks prep

RUL-single_gps_time_proposed.content: An offset the GPS time of one photo gives SHALL NOT take effect until the user accepts it.
RUL-single_gps_time_proposed.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-single_gps_time_proposed.title: One GPS time is a proposal

RUL-snapshot_after_validation.content: A snapshot SHALL be taken only after the plan has been validated against its dependencies.
RUL-snapshot_after_validation.title: A snapshot follows the plan's validation

RUL-snapshot_off_by_default.content: Snapshots SHALL be off unless the workspace's configuration turns them on.
RUL-snapshot_off_by_default.title: No snapshot unless configured

RUL-snapshot_optional.content:
A phase that changes files MAY first take a snapshot of what it is about to change, from which the whole change can be
rolled back. Cartographer SHALL be complete and safe without one, no guarantee depending on a snapshot having been
taken.
RUL-snapshot_optional.title: A snapshot is optional, and nothing rests on it

RUL-snapshot_per_plan.content: Each snapshot SHALL be identifiable by the plan whose changes it precedes.
RUL-snapshot_per_plan.title: A snapshot names its plan

RUL-snapshot_timing.content: A snapshot SHALL be taken before the plan's first change.
RUL-snapshot_timing.title: When a snapshot is taken

RUL-snapshot_under_lock.content: A snapshot SHALL be taken only while the lock is held.
RUL-snapshot_under_lock.title: A snapshot is taken under the lock

RUL-sort_photos_only.content:
Photos by destination SHALL hold only photos — videos stay in videos by date, and no file of no media class belongs
there.
RUL-sort_photos_only.title: Only photos are sorted into photos by destination

RUL-sort_recorded_by_stat.content:
A prep run after the latest sort SHALL record the moves from the files' sizes and modification times alone, carrying
each moved file's identity forward without reading it again.
RUL-sort_recorded_by_stat.title: Prep records a sort from sizes and times alone

RUL-sorting_passes.content:
A photo moved from photos by date into photos by destination, or moved within photos by destination — its folder
renamed among them — SHALL pass the comparison.
RUL-sorting_passes.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-sorting_passes.title: Sorting passes

RUL-spanning_workspace_located.content: The report of a workspace spanning filesystems SHALL name a folder in it that lies on another filesystem.
RUL-spanning_workspace_located.title: The stop names a folder that lies elsewhere

RUL-spanning_workspace_stops.content: A workspace found to span filesystems SHALL stop the run with nothing changed.
RUL-spanning_workspace_stops.title: A workspace spanning filesystems stops the run

RUL-split_move_never_lost.content:
Where a move cannot be one operation, an interruption, or a failure partway, SHALL leave the file whole under its old
name, its new name or both — never under neither, never part of one.
RUL-split_move_never_lost.title: A move that cannot be one operation is never lost

RUL-stale_acceptance_kept.content:
When a proposal has become another since the user accepted it, geotag SHALL leave the user's earlier acceptance in the
decision exactly as the user wrote it, for the user to replace.
RUL-stale_acceptance_kept.title: Geotag leaves the user's answer in place when its proposal changes

RUL-stale_confirmation_kept.content:
When a check is asked about again, geotag SHALL leave the user's earlier confirmation in the decision exactly as the
user wrote it, for the user to replace.
RUL-stale_confirmation_kept.title: Geotag leaves a confirmation asked about again as the user wrote it

RUL-stale_lock_recovered.content:
A lock left behind by a run that died SHALL be recognisable as stale, and recoverable, so that a crash never leaves a
workspace locked for good.
RUL-stale_lock_recovered.title: A stale lock is recognised and recovered

RUL-stale_takeover_conservative.content:
A lock SHALL be taken over only once the machine's own system reports that no running process holds it — never on what
the lock's record says of its owner. This guards the runs of one machine; where two machines reach one library over a
network, whether the lock holds between them is that filesystem's doing.
RUL-stale_takeover_conservative.title: A lock is taken over only once no running process holds it

RUL-staleness_by_area.content:
A change to one area of the configuration SHALL make stale only what depends on that area. A change to the track
thresholds restales placement and the plans, not the renames; a change to the filename format restales the renames,
not placement.
RUL-staleness_by_area.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-staleness_by_area.title: A change to one area restales only what depends on it

RUL-stay_fixes_no_clock.content:
An offset the camera's photos fix only to within a stay of the tracks at their place — longer than the configuration
counts as a moment — SHALL NOT take effect without the user's answer.
RUL-stay_fixes_no_clock.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-stay_fixes_no_clock.title: Where the tracks stood still, a place says no time

RUL-stay_offset_never_anchored.content: An offset fixed only to within a stay of the tracks SHALL NOT count as anchored once accepted.
RUL-stay_offset_never_anchored.section_name: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
sections: 11. Clock offsets from the camera’s own GPS
RUL-stay_offset_never_anchored.title: An offset from a stay is never anchored

RUL-stop_gives_acceptance_code.content:
A stop SHALL list the changes grouped by kind and by folder, and give the command to run again to accept them once,
with a code made from the list as printed.
RUL-stop_gives_acceptance_code.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-stop_gives_acceptance_code.title: A stop gives the code that accepts its list

RUL-stray_media_hint_names_extension.content: The warning that strays are images or videos SHALL name their extension.
RUL-stray_media_hint_names_extension.section_name: 5. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 5. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-stray_media_hint_names_extension.title: The warning names the strays' extension

RUL-stray_media_hinted.content: When files prep is about to set aside as strays are images or videos by their content, prep SHALL warn.
RUL-stray_media_hinted.section_name: 5. What prep refuses to work on
sections: 5. What prep refuses to work on
RUL-stray_media_hinted.title: Media set aside as strays is pointed out

RUL-strays_leave_no_trace.content:
A file prep moves to the strays folder SHALL be recorded nowhere but in the plan that moves it and the journal of that
move — no fingerprint, no row in the workspace database, no entry in the handoff or any log — the archival package
holding it only as it holds that plan.
RUL-strays_leave_no_trace.section_name: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
sections: 2. The workspace’s first run, and the strays
RUL-strays_leave_no_trace.title: A stray leaves no trace but its move

RUL-strays_never_processed.content: Nothing SHALL process the strays folder's contents again: prep writes into it, but never scans it.
RUL-strays_never_processed.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-strays_never_processed.title: The strays folder's contents are never processed again

RUL-structure_built_once.content: Prep SHALL create the full structure of managed folders exactly once, when it initializes the workspace.
RUL-structure_built_once.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-structure_built_once.title: Prep builds the structure once, and never removes a folder

RUL-suffix_case_insensitive.content: A name SHALL be taken when it matches a name on disk or planned in the run without regard to case.
RUL-suffix_case_insensitive.title: Names are compared without regard to case

RUL-suffix_choice_by_phase.content:
Prep and geotag SHALL take the first free name — the name with no suffix when it is free, otherwise the lowest free
suffix — by one identical rule.
RUL-suffix_choice_by_phase.title: Prep and geotag take the first free name

RUL-suffix_deterministic.content: The differentiating suffix SHALL be allocated deterministically.
RUL-suffix_deterministic.title: The suffix is allocated deterministically

RUL-suffix_in_capture_order.content:
Geotag SHALL give the photos of a destination that take new names of one timestamp their suffixes in the order they
were taken: by the fraction of a second each records, where it records one, then by the suffix its name already holds,
none first.
RUL-suffix_in_capture_order.title: The photos of one second keep the order they were taken in

RUL-suffix_no_clobber.content:
A file whose timestamp name is already taken SHALL get a differentiating suffix, allocated without clobbering: against
every name on disk and every name planned in the run, so that two files never collide.
RUL-suffix_no_clobber.title: A taken name gets a suffix, never clobbering

RUL-suffix_zero_padded.content: The differentiating suffix SHALL be zero-padded.
RUL-suffix_zero_padded.title: The suffix is zero-padded

RUL-target_free_at_execute.content:
Immediately before each change that gives a file a name — prep's moves, renames and setting duplicates aside, geotag's
renames, merge's placing in the library — execution SHALL check that the name is free, never writing onto a taken name
on the strength of the plan: a name found taken blocks that operation.
RUL-target_free_at_execute.title: Every name is checked free as it is written

RUL-target_free_ignores_case.content: Execution's check that a name is free SHALL ignore case where the filesystem does.
RUL-target_free_ignores_case.title: A name is checked free ignoring case

RUL-temp_name_own.content: A temporary copy SHALL bear a name of its own, which no photo bears.
RUL-temp_name_own.title: A temporary copy bears a name no photo bears

RUL-time_before_gps.content: Geotag SHALL plan no photo's position until every photo's true time is resolved.
RUL-time_before_gps.title: Time first, then position

RUL-time_field_first_valid.content: Prep SHALL take a time field from the first of those places holding a valid time in it.
RUL-time_field_first_valid.section_name: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
sections: 11. The metadata prep keeps for geotag
RUL-time_field_first_valid.title: A time field is taken from the first place holding a valid time

RUL-time_given_filed_on.content:
Prep SHALL file each media file in missing metadata that has gained a recorded time as it files one of a new dump: a
photo into photos by date, a video into videos by date, in its day's folder under its timestamp name.
RUL-time_given_filed_on.title: A file given a time in missing metadata is filed on

RUL-time_offset_written_beside.content: Geotag SHALL write beside each time it writes that time's offset from UTC.
RUL-time_offset_written_beside.title: The time's offset is written beside it

RUL-times_survive_unrelated_config_edits.content: A configuration change outside the camera-time policy SHALL NOT make stale the true times already resolved.
RUL-times_survive_unrelated_config_edits.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-times_survive_unrelated_config_edits.title: Resolved true times survive configuration edits outside the time policy

RUL-timezone_auto_resolves.content:
A timezone a destination inherits from the destination it lies in SHALL take effect without the user's answer — save
where the destination's own photos speak against it ({need}`RUL-inherited_timezone_yields_to_photos`).
RUL-timezone_auto_resolves.title: An inherited timezone applies itself

RUL-timezone_from_nearest.content:
A destination's proposed timezone SHALL be the one in effect at the nearest destination it lies in that has one —
however it was reached there.
RUL-timezone_from_nearest.title: A destination takes the nearest timezone it lies in

RUL-timezone_offset_asked_once.content:
A clock offset derived from the destination's timezone, or from the offset the camera's photos record, SHALL be asked
about once: at the check against the tracks where tracks lie by its photos, and by acceptance where none do.
RUL-timezone_offset_asked_once.title: A guessed offset is asked about once

RUL-tool_failure_never_valid.content: A file's fingerprint or metadata SHALL never be recorded as valid when the tool failed or crashed on it.
RUL-tool_failure_never_valid.section_name: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-tool_failure_never_valid.title: A tool's failure is never recorded as valid

RUL-tool_failure_retried.content:
A tool that fails or crashes on a file SHALL be restarted and tried again a bounded number of times before the file's
fingerprint or metadata is recorded as failed.
RUL-tool_failure_retried.section_name: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
sections: 15. Concurrency, determinism, and what a run shows
RUL-tool_failure_retried.title: A tool's failure is retried before it counts

RUL-top_level_only_managed.content:
The top level of an initialized workspace SHALL hold only the managed folders, the control records' place, the
quarantine and hidden entries, hidden files as much as hidden folders: any other entry — a file, a folder, a link, an
entry of any other kind — is a misplaced dump, whose only place is the
inbox, and blocks every phase alike.
RUL-top_level_only_managed.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-top_level_only_managed.title: The top level holds only what belongs there

RUL-track_break_never_bridged.content: Geotag SHALL NOT place a photo or anchor a clock across a break between two segments of one track.
RUL-track_break_never_bridged.title: A break in a recording is never bridged

RUL-track_confirmation_is_acceptance.content:
A timezone's offset, or one a camera's photos record, that the user confirms against the tracks SHALL count as
accepted by that confirmation ({need}`RUL-timezone_offset_asked_once`).
RUL-track_confirmation_is_acceptance.title: A confirmation against the tracks is an acceptance

RUL-track_evidence_order.content: Of the ways a track can place a photo, geotag SHALL take the first that applies: a track point at its time, the place between the two points around it, the place past an end of the track — an end being where that track's own recording starts, stops or breaks off.
RUL-track_evidence_order.title: A track's closest evidence is used first

RUL-track_file_left_in_place.content:
Prep SHALL leave a track file where it is: never moving it, to the strays folder or anywhere else, and never treating it
as a file of no media class.
RUL-track_file_left_in_place.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-track_file_left_in_place.title: A track file stays where it is

RUL-track_files_block_prep.content:
A track file — a recorded position log in any of the usual formats, whether or not geotag reads that format — found
anywhere prep inventories, in the dump or in a managed folder, SHALL block prep's plan.
RUL-track_files_block_prep.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-track_files_block_prep.title: A track file stops prep

RUL-track_is_one_trk.content: Geotag SHALL treat each track a track file holds as a track of its own, never joined to another of the same file.
RUL-track_is_one_trk.title: Each track of a file is a track of its own

RUL-track_link_named.content: A symbolic link under the tracks folder that geotag does not follow SHALL be named to the user.
RUL-track_link_named.title: A link under the tracks folder is named

RUL-track_link_never_followed.content: A symbolic link under the tracks folder SHALL never be followed.
RUL-track_link_never_followed.title: No link under the tracks folder is followed

RUL-track_never_written_in_photo.content: The track that gave a photo its position SHALL NOT be written in the photo.
RUL-track_never_written_in_photo.title: The track is not written in the photo

RUL-track_placement_bounded.content: A track SHALL place a photo only within the limits the configuration sets — never across a gap in time, a distance or a speed beyond them, and never farther past its end than they allow.
RUL-track_placement_bounded.title: The tracks place a photo only within the configured limits

RUL-track_points_kept.content: Geotag SHALL keep in the workspace database each track point its decisions reach, as it decided by it.
RUL-track_points_kept.title: The track points decided by are kept with the workspace

RUL-track_ranking_in_dependencies.content:
Geotag SHALL record the ranking of the tracks with their fingerprint, so that a change to the ranking makes stale every
record a change to the tracks would.
RUL-track_ranking_in_dependencies.title: The ranking is a dependency of what the tracks decide

RUL-track_time_never_guessed.content:
Geotag SHALL take a track point's time as the instant it states, whatever its precision or the offset it is written
with.
RUL-track_time_never_guessed.title: A track point's time is the instant it states

RUL-track_window_reaches_every_reader.content:
Geotag SHALL read, for each of its decisions, every track point that decision can reach by the settings that bound it —
the points read bounded by no setting of their own.
RUL-track_window_reaches_every_reader.title: Every point a decision can reach is read

RUL-trackless_confirmation_holds_while_n.content: A confirmation made where no track lay by the photos SHALL hold only while none lies by them.
RUL-trackless_confirmation_holds_while_n.title: A confirmation made with no track holds while there is none

RUL-tracks_elsewhere_restale_nothing.content: A change to the tracks at times no decision of geotag's reaches SHALL NOT make a record of geotag's stale.
RUL-tracks_elsewhere_restale_nothing.title: Tracks of other times restale nothing

RUL-tracks_geotag_only.content:
Geotag SHALL be the only phase that reads the tracks — scanning their location, parsing them, fingerprinting them and
using them as evidence; prep never reads, parses, fingerprints or moves them, nor otherwise acts on them.
RUL-tracks_geotag_only.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-tracks_geotag_only.title: Only geotag reads the tracks

RUL-tracks_in_dependencies.content:
Geotag SHALL record the tracks' fingerprint as a dependency of every record it derives with them — the time decisions,
the drift validation, the GPS decisions and the executable plan — so that a change to the tracks makes those records
stale.
RUL-tracks_in_dependencies.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-tracks_in_dependencies.title: The tracks are a dependency of what geotag derives from them

RUL-tracks_never_joined.content:
Geotag SHALL never place a photo from a point of one track file taken with a point of another, whether between the
two points or beyond them.
RUL-tracks_never_joined.title: A photo is placed from one track file only

RUL-tracks_never_joined_to_anchor.content: Geotag SHALL never join a point of one track file to a point of another to anchor a clock on the line between them.
RUL-tracks_never_joined_to_anchor.title: No clock is anchored between two tracks

RUL-tracks_outside_managed_folders.content:
The tracks' location SHALL lie outside the managed folders — neither inside one nor containing one — a configuration
that places it otherwise being refused before any phase uses it. Where outside them is the configuration's choice, not
part of this contract.
RUL-tracks_outside_managed_folders.section_name: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
sections: 7. The tracks, kept outside the managed folders
RUL-tracks_outside_managed_folders.title: The tracks lie outside the managed folders

RUL-tracks_ranked_by_folder.content:
Where the configuration ranks folders of the tracks, each track SHALL rank as the folder it is filed in, a track in no
ranked folder below every ranked one, and tracks of one rank alike.
RUL-tracks_ranked_by_folder.title: A track ranks by the folder it is filed in

RUL-unanchored_offset_confirmed.content:
Photos SHALL NOT be placed by the tracks on a clock offset the camera's own GPS does not support until the user has
confirmed that offset against the tracks.
RUL-unanchored_offset_confirmed.title: An offset the camera's GPS does not support is confirmed before photos are placed by it

RUL-unchanged_replan_writes_nothing.content: A re-plan whose result is identical to what is saved SHALL write nothing and set nothing aside.
RUL-unchanged_replan_writes_nothing.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-unchanged_replan_writes_nothing.title: An unchanged re-plan writes nothing

RUL-unchecked_counts_as_changed.content: A dependency that is missing, or cannot be checked, SHALL count as changed.
RUL-unchecked_counts_as_changed.section_name: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
sections: 8. Nothing used once what it came from has changed
RUL-unchecked_counts_as_changed.title: What cannot be checked counts as changed

RUL-uncorrected_keeps_its_name.content:
A file's name SHALL change between prep and geotag only when its timestamp is corrected, or its extension is not in
lowercase: geotag plans no rename for a file whose time is not corrected but to lowercase its extension.
RUL-uncorrected_keeps_its_name.title: An uncorrected file keeps its name

RUL-unexpected_change_stops.content:
Any other difference from the state the last execution left — a file changed in place or replaced, one appearing
outside the inbox, one gone from missing metadata, anything in the strays or the quarantine changed, a file moved where
no sorting goes — SHALL stop the command before it plans, validates or changes anything, naming each file.
RUL-unexpected_change_stops.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-unexpected_change_stops.title: Anything else stops the command, naming each file

RUL-unfingerprinted_photo_stops_geotag.content: Geotag SHALL NOT plan, execute or finalize while a photo in photos by destination has no fingerprint.
RUL-unfingerprinted_photo_stops_geotag.title: A photo with no fingerprint stops geotag

RUL-unfingerprinted_photo_stops_merge.content: Merge SHALL NOT plan or execute while a photo in photos by destination has no fingerprint.
RUL-unfingerprinted_photo_stops_merge.title: A photo with no fingerprint stops merge

RUL-unidentified_files_solved_alone.content:
A file whose metadata names no camera SHALL be solved on its own — by the offset recorded with its time, else its
destination's timezone once accepted ({need}`RUL-camera_less_files_asked_per_destination`).
RUL-unidentified_files_solved_alone.title: A file naming no camera is solved on its own

RUL-unidentified_never_classed.content: A file whose metadata names no camera SHALL never be asked to be classed.
RUL-unidentified_never_classed.title: A file naming no camera is never asked to be classed

RUL-unidentified_no_camera_offset.content: A file whose metadata names no camera SHALL never be given a camera's clock offset.
RUL-unidentified_no_camera_offset.title: A file naming no camera takes no camera's offset

RUL-unknown_decision_field_refused.content: A field written into a photo's position decision that the decision does not have SHALL be an error, naming the field.
RUL-unknown_decision_field_refused.section_name: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
sections: 14. Every value the user writes is checked
RUL-unknown_decision_field_refused.title: A photo's position decision holds only its own fields

RUL-unknown_group_classification_offered.content: Geotag SHALL offer the classification of every unknown camera group ready to paste into the configuration.
RUL-unknown_group_classification_offered.title: The classification is offered ready to paste

RUL-unknown_group_stops_geotag.content: Geotag SHALL NOT decide anything while a camera group in photos by destination is unknown.
RUL-unknown_group_stops_geotag.title: An unknown camera group stops geotag

RUL-unknown_setting_named.content: A run stopped by a setting cartographer does not know SHALL name the setting.
RUL-unknown_setting_named.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-unknown_setting_named.title: The unknown setting is named

RUL-unlisted_extension_other.content: An extension the configuration does not list SHALL be `other`.
RUL-unlisted_extension_other.section_name: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
sections: 3. One configuration, kept in the workspace
RUL-unlisted_extension_other.title: An extension not listed is other

RUL-unlisted_tracks_stop_geotag.content: Geotag SHALL NOT plan or execute while its tracks folder, or a folder within it, cannot be listed.
RUL-unlisted_tracks_stop_geotag.title: Tracks that cannot be listed stop geotag

RUL-unplaced_photo_listed.content:
Every photo no source places SHALL be listed for the user by itself, until a position is set for it or a fallback for
its folder.
RUL-unplaced_photo_listed.title: An unplaced photo is listed

RUL-unplaced_photo_run_partial.content: A merge run that leaves a photo unplaced SHALL be partial.
RUL-unplaced_photo_run_partial.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-unplaced_photo_run_partial.title: A run that leaves a photo unplaced is partial

RUL-unplaced_photo_says_why.content: A photo listed as unplaced SHALL be listed with why the tracks did not place it.
RUL-unplaced_photo_says_why.title: An unplaced photo is listed with why

RUL-unplaced_photo_stays.content: A photo merge cannot place SHALL stay where it is.
RUL-unplaced_photo_stays.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-unplaced_photo_stays.title: A photo merge cannot place stays where it is

RUL-unplaced_photo_waits.content: A photo none of these places SHALL wait for the user to set a position for it or a fallback for its folder.
RUL-unplaced_photo_waits.title: A photo nothing places waits for the user

RUL-unread_plan_never_run_passed.content:
Finalize SHALL NOT pass over a plan set aside that it cannot read unless the records show no execution ran it — no
execution's summary names it, and no execution's journal can be its.
RUL-unread_plan_never_run_passed.title: A kept plan no execution ran is passed over unread

RUL-unreadable_execution_record_stops.content:
Geotag's execution and finalize SHALL NOT take a record of an earlier execution that they cannot read for none: they
stop before they change or write anything, naming it.
RUL-unreadable_execution_record_stops.title: A record of an earlier execution that cannot be read stops geotag

RUL-unreadable_manifest_kept.content:
Prep SHALL stop rather than write over a quarantine record it cannot read and cannot set aside, the file it was to
quarantine left where it was.
RUL-unreadable_manifest_kept.title: An unreadable quarantine record is never written over

RUL-unreadable_offset_tag_is_none.content: A photo's offset tag holding something that is no offset SHALL be read as no tag, never loosely.
RUL-unreadable_offset_tag_is_none.title: An offset tag that is no offset is read as none

RUL-unreadable_offset_tag_recorded.content: Each photo whose offset tag holds no offset SHALL be recorded in the time decisions as such, with what the tag holds.
RUL-unreadable_offset_tag_recorded.title: An offset tag that is no offset is recorded

RUL-unreadable_offset_tag_told.content: Geotag SHALL tell the user of each photo whose offset tag holds no offset, naming the photo.
RUL-unreadable_offset_tag_told.title: An offset tag that is no offset is told

RUL-unreadable_plan_replanned.content:
Each command that reads geotag's executable plan — its execution, finalize, merge's plan and the summary shown before
an execution — SHALL stop on one it cannot read, changing nothing, and send the user to plan again.
RUL-unreadable_plan_replanned.title: A plan that cannot be read is made again

RUL-unreadable_point_reported.content: A track point geotag skips SHALL be reported to the user, naming its file and point.
RUL-unreadable_point_reported.title: A track point geotag skips is reported

RUL-unreadable_point_skipped.content:
A track point geotag cannot use — no position or one out of range, no time, an unreadable time, or one stating no
zone — SHALL be skipped.
RUL-unreadable_point_skipped.title: A track point geotag cannot use is skipped

RUL-unreadable_prep_log_stops.content:
Prep SHALL stop, before any change and naming the file, where its earlier log exists and cannot be read — never taking
it for an empty log.
RUL-unreadable_prep_log_stops.title: An unreadable log stops prep

RUL-unreadable_tracks_stop_geotag.content: Geotag SHALL NOT plan while its tracks folder holds track files of which not one can be read.
RUL-unreadable_tracks_stop_geotag.title: Tracks none of which can be read stop geotag

RUL-unreadable_zone_table_record_stops.content:
A run that reads a workspace's record of the answer to whether to download the table of countries SHALL stop, before
any change and naming the record, where it exists and cannot be read — never taking it for no answer.
RUL-unreadable_zone_table_record_stops.title: An unreadable record of the answer stops the run

RUL-unrequired_snapshot_proceeds.content:
When snapshots are not required, or not configured, a run SHALL proceed without one. Its safety then rests, as it
always does, on the journal, the recoverable quarantine, never overwriting, and the filesystem as the truth.
RUL-unrequired_snapshot_proceeds.title: Without a required snapshot, the run goes on

RUL-unsettled_collision_blocks.content:
Where the library file in an incoming photo's place cannot be fingerprinted, merge SHALL leave that photo in photos by
destination — neither placing it there nor under another name.
RUL-unsettled_collision_blocks.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-unsettled_collision_blocks.title: A collision that cannot be settled holds the photo back

RUL-unsettled_collision_rest_proceeds.content: Where a collision that cannot be settled holds one photo back, merge SHALL go on with the rest.
RUL-unsettled_collision_rest_proceeds.section_name: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
sections: 13. Merge: the library kept, the workspace sealed
RUL-unsettled_collision_rest_proceeds.title: A photo held back does not stop the rest

RUL-untagged_phone_photo_asked.content:
A phone's photos recording no offset that neither its tagged photos nor its own GPS settle SHALL be asked about once,
as a camera's guessed offset is: at the check against the tracks where tracks lie by them, by acceptance where none do.
RUL-untagged_phone_photo_asked.section_name: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
sections: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
RUL-untagged_phone_photo_asked.title: With neither, the phone's photo is asked about once

RUL-untagged_phone_photo_read_as_sibling.content:
A phone's photo recording no offset with its time SHALL be read by its destination's timezone without the user's answer
only where at least one of the same phone's photos of that day there records an offset with its time, and every one that
does records the zone's.
RUL-untagged_phone_photo_read_as_sibling.section_name: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
sections: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
RUL-untagged_phone_photo_read_as_sibling.title: A phone's photo with no offset is read by the zone only as its tagged ones show

RUL-untagged_phone_photo_settled_by_evid.content:
Where its tagged photos do not, a phone's photos of a day in a destination recording no offset SHALL be read, without
the user's answer, by the offset the phone's own GPS gives that day there, where it agrees with how its photos giving it
are read.
RUL-untagged_phone_photo_settled_by_evid.section_name: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
sections: 12. A phone’s clock, checked against its own GPS
RUL-untagged_phone_photo_settled_by_evid.title: Else the phone's own GPS reads it

RUL-untimed_mark_once.content:
A file that comes in under a name already carrying the untimed mark SHALL keep that name as its untimed name, the mark
not added again.
RUL-untimed_mark_once.title: The untimed mark is taken once

RUL-untimed_photo_named.content:
A photo that stops geotag for carrying no recorded time SHALL be named to the user as wanting a date fallback for its
folder, or else belonging in missing metadata.
RUL-untimed_photo_named.title: A photo with no recorded time is named

RUL-untimed_photo_stops_geotag.content:
A photo in photos by destination carrying no recorded time, which no date fallback covers, SHALL stop geotag before it
resolves any photo's time.
RUL-untimed_photo_stops_geotag.title: A photo with no recorded time and no date fallback stops geotag

RUL-untimed_to_missing_metadata.content:
Prep SHALL put each media file it takes in with no recorded time directly into missing metadata, no day folder between,
under its untimed name.
RUL-untimed_to_missing_metadata.title: Media with no recorded time goes to missing metadata

RUL-untouched_check_confirms_nothing.content: A check against the tracks left untouched SHALL never count as a confirmation.
RUL-untouched_check_confirms_nothing.title: An untouched check confirms nothing

RUL-unused_points_not_kept.content:
Geotag SHALL keep no track point that lies outside what the decisions of its latest planning reach, unless an executed
plan used it.
RUL-unused_points_not_kept.title: No point is kept that nothing rests on

RUL-user_backup_is_a_stray.content: A backup that the user's own edit of a photo left beside it — the photo as it was before that edit — SHALL be treated as any file of no media class, never as what a write of cartographer's left.
RUL-user_backup_is_a_stray.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-user_backup_is_a_stray.title: A backup the user's own edit left is the user's file

RUL-user_writes_decisions.content: A decision field SHALL be written by the user alone, no phase ever overwriting what the user wrote.
RUL-user_writes_decisions.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-user_writes_decisions.title: The user writes the decisions

RUL-video_name_stays_uncorrected.content: Geotag SHALL NOT correct a video's name: the name prep gives a video from its camera's clock, uncorrected, is final.
RUL-video_name_stays_uncorrected.title: A video keeps the name prep gave it

RUL-video_never_changed.content: Geotag SHALL never change a video.
RUL-video_never_changed.title: Geotag changes no video

RUL-videos_by_date.content: Prep SHALL put each video it takes in that has a recorded time into videos by date, under its timestamp name.
RUL-videos_by_date.section_name: 1. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
sections: 1. What prep does, and what it leaves alone
RUL-videos_by_date.title: Prep puts videos by date

RUL-who_checks_for_links.content: Prep SHALL check for links across the whole tree it walks, the destination tree included though prep never changes it.
RUL-who_checks_for_links.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-who_checks_for_links.title: Prep checks the whole tree for links

RUL-withdrawal_keeps_destination.content: Withdrawing a decision SHALL never move a file out of its destination.
RUL-withdrawal_keeps_destination.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-withdrawal_keeps_destination.title: A withdrawal never moves a file out of its destination

RUL-withdrawal_recomputes_time_and_name.content: After a decision is withdrawn, a time and a name SHALL be recomputed where the file stands.
RUL-withdrawal_recomputes_time_and_name.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-withdrawal_recomputes_time_and_name.title: After a withdrawal the time and the name are recomputed in place

RUL-withdrawal_undoes.content:
Withdrawing a decision SHALL undo its effect, not merely stop asserting it: a manual position withdrawn gives the file
the position it would have had without it — from the tracks or its folder's fallback; a position derived by the tool is
derived again.
RUL-withdrawal_undoes.section_name: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
sections: 11. Nothing changes that the user did not write down
RUL-withdrawal_undoes.title: Withdrawing a decision undoes it

RUL-withdrawn_track_points_kept.content:
The points of a track file by which an executed plan placed or timed photos SHALL stay in the workspace database, marked
withdrawn, once the file is gone or changed.
RUL-withdrawn_track_points_kept.title: The points an executed plan rests on stay

RUL-workspace_checked_first.content:
Every plan, dry run, execution and finalize of every phase SHALL first compare the workspace's files with the state the
last execution left them in, by their file system entries alone and reading no file, before it plans, validates or
changes anything.
RUL-workspace_checked_first.section_name: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
sections: 17. The workspace as the last execution left it
RUL-workspace_checked_first.title: Every run first checks the workspace is as the last execution left it

RUL-workspace_local_filesystem.content:
A workspace SHALL lie on a local filesystem — on the machine's own disks or in its memory, never on one reached over a
network — whatever its configuration says.
RUL-workspace_local_filesystem.title: A workspace lies on a local filesystem

RUL-workspace_moves_one_filesystem.content: A move by prep or geotag that would cross filesystems SHALL fail, never be made a copy.
RUL-workspace_moves_one_filesystem.title: Prep and geotag never move across filesystems

RUL-workspace_one_filesystem.content:
A workspace SHALL lie on one filesystem, every folder in it — the control records' and the set-aside duplicates'
among them — on the same one.
RUL-workspace_one_filesystem.title: A workspace lies on one filesystem

RUL-write_leftovers_by_dest_warned.content:
A temporary file that an interrupted metadata write left in photos by destination, which prep never changes,
SHALL be left where it is and the user warned of it.
RUL-write_leftovers_by_dest_warned.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-write_leftovers_by_dest_warned.title: Such a leftover in photos by destination is warned of

RUL-write_leftovers_quarantined.content:
A temporary file that an interrupted metadata write left beside a photo, in a folder prep may change, SHALL
be moved to the recoverable quarantine — never taken for media, never put among the strays.
RUL-write_leftovers_quarantined.section_name: 4. The control records, apart from the media
sections: 4. The control records, apart from the media
RUL-write_leftovers_quarantined.title: What an interrupted metadata write left is quarantined

RUL-written_fallback_over_inherited.content:
A folder fallback the user writes for a destination SHALL take effect there, for every photo there the fallback places,
over the one it inherits.
RUL-written_fallback_over_inherited.title: A fallback written for a destination outranks the one it inherits

RUL-written_timezone_over_inherited.content: A timezone the user writes for a destination SHALL take effect over the one it inherits.
RUL-written_timezone_over_inherited.title: A written timezone outranks an inherited one

RUL-written_value_over_acceptance.content: A value the user writes for a decision SHALL take effect over a proposal accepted for the same decision.
RUL-written_value_over_acceptance.title: A written value outranks an accepted proposal

RUL-zone_against_photos_needs_word.content:
A destination's timezone, written or inherited, SHALL NOT take effect while a photo there, read by the offset recorded
with its time, records an offset that timezone does not have at the photo's time — until the user confirms the
timezone for the offsets those photos record.
RUL-zone_against_photos_needs_word.title: A timezone stands against the photos only on the user's word

RUL-zone_among_countrys_only.content: A timezone answered for a destination in a country of several timezones SHALL be one of that country's timezones.
RUL-zone_among_countrys_only.title: A timezone answered in a country is one of its own

RUL-zone_asked_at_every_level.content:
A container destination with no timezone, written or inherited, SHALL ask for one while a destination within it waits
for one that a timezone written at the container would reach.
RUL-zone_asked_at_every_level.title: A timezone is asked at every folder above a destination waiting for one

RUL-zone_from_photos_applies.content:
A timezone proposed from the offsets a destination's photos record within its country SHALL take effect without the
user's answer.
RUL-zone_from_photos_applies.title: A timezone the photos give within their country applies itself

RUL-zone_from_photos_in_country.content:
A destination in a country of several timezones, with no timezone written or inherited, SHALL be proposed the one
timezone of that country whose offset at the time of each of its photos read by the offset recorded with its time is
that offset — where exactly one is, and at least one photo records an offset.
RUL-zone_from_photos_in_country.title: In a country of several timezones, the photos' offsets propose the one that fits

RUL-zone_not_asked_where_one_reaches.content:
A container destination with a timezone, written there or inherited, or where a country of several timezones is said,
SHALL NOT be asked for one.
RUL-zone_not_asked_where_one_reaches.title: A container a timezone reaches is not asked for one

RUL-zone_table_asked_once.content:
A workspace's answer to whether to download the table of countries SHALL be kept with it, the question not asked
again.
RUL-zone_table_asked_once.title: The question of the table is asked once

RUL-zone_table_checked.content:
A download of the table of countries that does not give it whole and well formed SHALL be refused, the table in use
before staying in use.
RUL-zone_table_checked.title: A table downloaded is taken only whole and well formed

RUL-zone_table_copy_kept.content: A table of countries downloaded for a workspace SHALL be kept among its control records.
RUL-zone_table_copy_kept.title: A table downloaded is kept with the workspace

RUL-zone_table_download_on_word.content: The table of countries SHALL NOT be downloaded but on the user's permission, asked for before.
RUL-zone_table_download_on_word.title: The table is downloaded only on the user's word

RUL-zone_table_download_where_missing.content: The table of countries SHALL NOT be downloaded, nor the user asked to, where the host's zone database has it.
RUL-zone_table_download_where_missing.title: The table is downloaded only where the host has none

RUL-zone_table_downloaded_once.content: A permission to download the table of countries SHALL download it once, by the run it is given to.
RUL-zone_table_downloaded_once.title: A permission downloads the table once

RUL-zone_table_failure_told.content:
The user SHALL be told of a download of the table of countries that failed or was refused, and that another table
stays in use.
RUL-zone_table_failure_told.title: A download that failed is told

RUL-zone_table_host_first.content:
The countries a destination can be said to be in, with their timezones, SHALL be read from the host's zone database
where it has them; else from a copy downloaded for the workspace; else from the copy cartographer carries.
RUL-zone_table_host_first.title: The table of countries is the host's, else the workspace's, else the one carried

RUL-zone_table_never_stops_prep.content: Prep SHALL go on, the copy cartographer carries in use, where nobody answers whether to download the table of countries.
RUL-zone_table_never_stops_prep.title: The question of the table never stops prep

RUL-zone_table_refusal_told.content:
The user asked whether to download the table of countries SHALL be told that refusing leaves in use the copy
cartographer carries, which may be stale.
RUL-zone_table_refusal_told.title: Asked to download, the user is told what refusing leaves

RUL-zone_table_request_bare.content: A download of the table of countries SHALL NOT carry anything of the workspace, the host or the user.
RUL-zone_table_request_bare.title: The download carries nothing of the user

RUL-zone_table_restales_plan.content:
Geotag's executable plan SHALL record the table of countries it was made from and where that came from, so that
another table makes it stale.
RUL-zone_table_restales_plan.title: Another table of countries makes the plan stale

RUL-zone_table_zone_known.content: A timezone the table of countries names that the host's zone database does not know SHALL be given to no country.
RUL-zone_table_zone_known.title: A timezone the host does not know is no country's

TST-audit_backfill-camera_group_key_vers.title: test camera group key version staleness refreshes

TST-audit_backfill-first_free_suffix_fil.title: test first free suffix fills a gap
